plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness bundle: Serena MCP integration - IDE-grade symbolic code intelligence (find/rename/edit symbols) for DSH agents, plus tool-usage hooks bridge
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-serena

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/akash-digitavision/dsh-serena)

**One-line value:** install this and every DeepSeek Harness agent gains IDE-grade symbolic code intelligence — `find_symbol`, `find_referencing_symbols`, `rename_symbol`, `replace_symbol_body`, `get_symbols_overview` and more — via the [Serena](https://github.com/oraios/serena) MCP server, plus session hooks that keep agents actually using it.

**Capability category:** 工具与能力 (Tools & Capabilities)
**License:** MIT · **Compatibility:** DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2 (bundles API); Windows/macOS/Linux; Python ≥ 3.11 for the Serena CLI

## What it adds to every agent on the profile

| Row | Module | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `mcp-serena` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` | Spawns the Serena MCP server (stdio) → `mcp__serena__*` tools: symbol search & overview, find references/implementations/declarations, rename & safe-delete symbols, symbolic editing, per-project memories, diagnostics |
| `dsh-hooks-claude-code` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` (dependency of this bundle) | Runs `~/.dsh/hooks.json`: session-start project activation prompt, tool-drift reminders toward Serena's tools, stop cleanup |

Launched with `--context claude-code --project-from-cwd`: each session auto-activates its workspace as the Serena project, and tools that duplicate DSH built-ins (file read/search/shell) stay hidden.

## Install

**One command (recommended):**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:akash-digitavision/dsh-serena
```

or in **Settings → Plugin Market** (DSH Plugin Hub), search for `dsh-serena`.

### Prerequisites

1. **The Serena CLI** — the official install puts `serena` on your PATH (the bundle's default):
   ```bash
   # install uv first: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/
   uv tool install -p 3.13 serena-agent
   ```
   Custom location? Point the bundle at it:
   ```powershell
   setx SERENA_COMMAND "C:\path\to\serena.exe"
   ```
   > **Windows note (Smart App Control / WDAC):** application-control policies may block uv-managed unsigned Python builds. Workaround: build a venv from a trusted/signed interpreter, `pip install serena-agent` into it, and `setx SERENA_COMMAND` to that venv's `serena.exe`.
2. **The hooks file** `~/.dsh/hooks.json` (Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\hooks.json`) — copy [`hooks.template.json`](./hooks.template.json):
   ```json
   {
     "SessionStart": [{ "matcher": "", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "serena-hooks activate --client=claude-code" }] }],
     "PreToolUse":    [{ "matcher": "", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "serena-hooks remind --client=claude-code" }] }],
     "Stop":          [{ "matcher": "", "hooks": [{ "type": "command", "command": "serena-hooks cleanup --client=claude-code" }] }]
   }
   ```
   `serena-hooks` ships with `uv tool install serena-agent`. If it is not on the DSH process PATH, use the absolute path to the executable in the template.

Then **restart DeepSeek Harness**. Verify by asking an agent: *"activate this project with serena"*.

## Permissions & external services

- Spawns a local `serena` MCP server process (language servers may download per-language tooling on demand)
- Reads/writes only your activated project workspaces; memories stored per-project in `.serena/`
- No accounts, no API keys, no telemetry

## Known limitations

- The hooks-bridge dependency is version-pinned (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` `0.2.0-rc.2`); if your DSH runtime is newer and install is rejected for peer incompatibility, match the version to your runtime
- First symbol query in a new project downloads that language's language server — first call can be slow

## Uninstall

Remove `dsh-serena` from the profile `dsh.profile.bundles` + `dependencies` (or `dsh plugin remove`), then restart the host. The Serena CLI, venv and hooks file are independent of the bundle.

## Credits

Upstream: [oraios/serena](https://github.com/oraios/serena) (MIT / GPL-3.0) — this bundle only wires it into DeepSeek Harness.

plugins.readme_text: # DSHCordis 两个用于 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的插件：余额查询、空闲时段发送。当前源码版本为 **0.2.2**（新增插件图标，发布后可安装），开发接口参考 DSH **0.2.0-rc.2**。 | 插件名称 | npm 包名 | 功能 | | --- | --- | --- | | [余额查询](./packages/balance/README.md) | [@liming999/balance](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@liming999/balance) | 在底边栏显示余额，可配置工作与非工作时的查询频率 | | [空闲时段发送](./packages/offpeak/README.md) | [@liming999/offpeak](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@liming999/offpeak) | 等待空闲时段发送草稿，提供今日时段提示和空闲日历 | ## 在 DSH 插件界面安装 打开 DSH 插件管理中的安装入口，在“填入插件 npm 包名”处输入以下内容，分别安装。 **余额查询：** ```text @liming999/balance ``` **空闲时段发送：** ```text @liming999/offpeak ``` 输入框只填写包名，不填写 `npm install`、`dsh plugin add` 或网页链接。安装后完全退出并重启 DSH；中文插件列表显示“余额查询”和“空闲时段发送”。 如果之前安装过旧名称 `@dshcordis/balance` 或 `@dshcordis/offpeak`，先在插件管理器中移除旧包，再安装新包，避免重复注册。 ## 使用命令行安装 使用 DSH Desktop 的 `desktop` profile 时，在终端执行： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add @liming999/balance dsh plugin --profile desktop add @liming999/offpeak ``` 其他 profile 请将 `desktop` 替换为实际名称。安装或更新后完全退出并重启 DSH；如果出现 warnings 或启用失败，应先处理错误。 ## 余额查询 - 在输入框底边栏显示余额，点击可查看总余额、赠送余额和充值余额。 - 支持 DeepSeek API Key 和登录账户；API Key 模式不要求登录，自动模式优先使用 API Key。 - 任一会话的 Agent 工作时默认每 **30 秒**查询，否则默认每 **5 分钟**查询。 - 在 **设置 → 插件 → 余额查询** 中调整频率，工作时支持 **10 秒**查询。 - 配置保存在当前浏览器，同源窗口同步。非官方代理地址不支持 API Key 余额查询。 详细说明见 [余额查询 README](./packages/balance/README.md)。 ## 空闲时段发送 先关闭开关编辑草稿，再开启开关。高峰时段会暂停编辑并显示倒计时；进入空闲时段后自动提交一次当前非空草稿。关闭开关可取消等待并恢复编辑。当前为空闲时段时，仍由用户正常提交。 按北京时间判断： | 日期类型 | 空闲时段 | | --- | --- | | 工作日，包括调休工作日 | 00:00–09:00、12:00–14:00、18:00–24:00 | | 节假日和休息日 | 全天 | 鼠标悬停开关可查看今日空闲时段；在 **设置 → 插件 → 空闲时段日历** 中查看月历。内置 2024–2026 年节假日安排，未收录年份按普通工作日近似判断并显示提示。 插件不是后台定时任务，退出 DSH 后不会发送。切换会话、隐藏页面、关闭开关或状态读取失败会取消当前等待；会话运行中不自动排队。该规则不查询实时价格，实际费用以服务商计费为准。 详细说明见 [空闲时段发送 README](./packages/offpeak/README.md)。 ## 仓库内容 `packages/balance` 和 `packages/offpeak` 包含插件源码、已构建的 `lib`、语言文件和安装声明。npm 包包含预构建代码，用户安装时不需要自行构建。本仓库公开内容以插件包和使用说明为主。 两个插件均使用 MIT 许可证，详见各包的 LICENSE。

plugins.description: Dsh Harness 定时备份插件：把 DSH 的记忆层（记忆/技能/待办/会话/存储）打包为 AES-256-GCM 加密归档，本地留存并同步到 WebDAV 与 GitHub 私有仓库，零第三方运行时依赖。
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH-Sync-Backup 使用指南

> **一句话**：把 DSH 的**记忆层**（记忆 / 技能 / 待办 / 会话 / 存储）打包成**加密归档**，留在本地并同步到 WebDAV 与 GitHub 私有仓库——**两条通道、两份可独立回读校验的副本，默认零外传**。
>
> 本指南按真实使用场景组织，每个场景讲「适合谁、能做什么、怎么用、会得到什么」。
>
> 相关文档：[详细功能说明](README-详细说明.md) · [架构与不变量](docs/architecture.md) · [测试与验收](docs/testing.md) · [版本号方案](docs/VERSIONING.md)

---
## 测试中
插件功能还在破坏式迭代中，谨慎安装！！！

## 快速开始（安装）

插件包内自带 `cordis.patch.yml`（`dsh.bundle.patch` 声明），装好后 **host 端自动注册，无需手动改 profile**。

> ⚠️ **填地址时别填网页 URL。** 插件页只接受四种 **spec**：**npm 包名** / **Git 地址** / **压缩包（tarball URL 或本地 .tgz）** / **本地绝对路径**。
> 形如 `https://github.com/用户/仓库/tree/main` 的**网页地址不在其中**，会报
> `无法识别这个包名或地址：a URL must point at a git repository or a tarball`。
> 下面每种客户端都给了可直接粘贴的 spec。

### 插件页（桌面版 / 网页版通用）

侧栏 → **插件** → **添加插件** → 粘贴下面任意一行 → 安装 → **完全退出并重启** DSH。

```text
dsh-sync-backup
```
```text
https://github.com/YAN3RA/DSH-Sync-Backup/archive/refs/tags/V1.5-261011.tar.gz
```
```text
git+https://github.com/YAN3RA/DSH-Sync-Backup.git
```

**三种 spec 怎么选：**

| spec | 需要什么 | 适合谁 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dsh-sync-backup` | 已发布到 npm registry | **最省事**，装机首选 |
| `https://.../archive/refs/tags/<tag>.tar.gz` | 能访问 GitHub | **最可靠**：纯 HTTPS 下载，不调用 `git`、不需要 SSH key，也不受代理/网络策略影响 |
| `git+https://github.com/...` | 本机 `git` 可用且能连通 GitHub | 想跟随最新提交 |

> 📌 **公司网络 / 代理环境优先用 tarball 那行。** `git+` 形式需要 pnpm 能成功 spawn `git`；某些网络策略下会直接失败，而 tarball 只走 HTTPS。

> ⚠️ 别用 `github:用户/仓库` 简写——pnpm 会把它解析成 **SSH** 地址（`git+ssh://git@github.com/...`），本机没配 SSH key 时会报 `[EPERM] spawn EPERM`。

### 命令行（CLI / web 版）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-sync-backup
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/YAN3RA/DSH-Sync-Backup/archive/refs/tags/V1.5-261011.tar.gz
dsh plugin --profile desktop add git+https://github.com/YAN3RA/DSH-Sync-Backup.git
```

桌面版自带 CLI 在 `<程序目录>\\resources\\runtime\\cli\\bin\\dsh.cmd`，**必须先完全退出桌面应用**再执行。

### 本地目录（开发用）

```sh
dsh plugin gate <插件目录>
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<插件目录>
```

> ⚠️ **不要再往 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 手动 insert 本插件**：bundle patch 已自动注册，重复 insert 同一个 id 会让加载器报 duplicate loader entry id 而无法启动。

装好后打开 **设置 → 备份与同步**，会看到四个页签：**概览 / 产物文件 / 通道配置 / 环境和维护**。

**卸载 / 回滚**：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-sync-backup`

**改默认配置**：在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里用 id 覆盖（顶层写法，不是 insert）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-sync-backup
  config:
    intervalHours: 6        # 本地打包周期从 12h 改成 6h
```

**插件异常导致 DSH 起不来时临时禁用**（无需卸载）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-sync-backup
  disabled: true
```

---

## 认识它（30 秒）

装上之后你会多出：

- **一个设置分区**「备份与同步」，四个页签管住全部行为；
- **两个 AI 工具**：`sync_backup_run`（立刻跑一次）与 `sync_backup_status`（看状态）；
- **一段提示词小节**，让 AI 知道这些工具存在、边界在哪。

一句话概括：**你的 DSH 记忆层，从此有加密的本地副本 + 两份异地副本，而且默认什么都不往外发。**

> 小提示：三个「外传」闸门默认都是关的——`dryRun: true`、`webdavEnabled: false`（patch 置 true 但不填目标即跳过）、`githubEnabled: false`。**你必须主动填目标、开开关、再关 dryRun，才会真正出网。**

---

## 场景一：换电脑 / 重装 DSH，不再从零开始

**适合谁**：所有人。这是本插件的核心价值。

DSH 的记忆散在 `~/.dsh` 里：全局人格 `AGENTS.md`、长期记忆 `memory/`、技能 `skills/`、待办 `task-board/`、定时任务 `storages/schedule.json`、会话记录 `sessions/`。前面这些**官方备份插件（dsh-config-manager）并不覆盖**——它管的是配置，不管记忆。

本插件做的就是补上这一段：白名单收集这些路径 → 打成 tar → **AES-256-GCM 加密** → 留在本地 + 上传两处。

**怎么用**：

1. 装好插件，重启 DSH；
2. 打开「设置 → 备份与同步 → 通道配置」，填 WebDAV 或 GitHub 目标（或都填）；
3. 用插件自带的脚本录一次凭据（**不要**把口令写进配置文件）：
   ```sh
   node tools/set-webdav-password.mjs --verify
   node tools/set-github-token.mjs --verify
   ```
4. 把 `dryRun` 关掉，然后跑一次：`sync_backup_run(upload: true)`。

**会得到什么**：本地 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-sync-backup/artifacts/` 下有加密归档，远端有两份，每个通道都会**回读校验 SHA256**——PUT 返回 2xx 不算成功，读回来字节对得上才算。

---

## 场景二：定时自动备份，睡前不用管

**适合谁**：不想手动点、希望一直有兜底的人。

插件自带自排期定时器（`schedulerEnabled`，默认开）：

- **本地打包周期** `intervalHours`（默认 12 小时）；
- **远端同步周期** `remoteIntervalHours`（默认 0 = 每次本地打包后立刻同步；可以设成 24 实现「一天本地跑 4 次、远端只传 1 次」）；
- **启动补跑**：距上次成功超过 `startupMinIntervalMs`（默认 1 小时）就立即补一次；
- **失败退避**：连续失败时排期按倍数拉长，上限 `maxBackoffHours`（默认 24 小时）。

> ⚠️ **定时跑默认只做本地打包（零网络）**。要让它自动上传，必须**同时**满足 `uploadOnSchedule: true` **且** `dryRun: false`。两者都是写类动作，改之前请确认。

---

## 场景三：两份异地副本，一份坏了还有一份

**适合谁**：对「数据真的还在」有要求的人。

两个通道**使用同一份载荷、同一个归档 id**，但彼此独立：

- **WebDAV**：往你的网盘发（坚果云、自建等），走 Basic 认证；
- **GitHub**：走 contents API 写**私有仓库**，每次 4 个文件——归档本体 + manifest + `latest.tar.gz` 稳定副本 + `index.json` 索引。

**一个通道失败不会中止另一个**。结果里 `partial: true` 表示半失败；连续 `partialAlertAfter`（默认 3）轮半失败会把状态置为 `needsAttention`，概览页健康条变红提示你介入。

**安全边界**：

- **非本机 http 一律拒绝**。Basic 口令与 Bearer 令牌在明文 HTTP 下等于直接交出去。只有 loopback（`127.0.0.1` / `[::1]`）放行 http；真要用内网私服，得显式打开 `webdavAllowInsecureHttp`。
- **上传被两道闸门卡住**：`dryRun: true` 时 `upload: true` 直接被拒；放行后也必须是「凭据解析 → 目标解析 → MKCOL → PUT → 回读 SHA256」全对才算成功。
- **设置页本身不能上传**。它的端点全是本地操作，唯二「够得着外面」的是 `save-config`（写你自己的 config.json）和 `export-recovery-code`（把你的密钥交给你自己）。

---

## 场景四：只备份你想要的

**适合谁**：磁盘紧张，或者只想保关键东西的人。

「环境和维护」页里可以逐个勾选备份条目，每项都标了**风险等级**和**在本机的实际体积**：

| 条目 | 内容 | 风险 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `persona` | 全局人格与行为指令 | 低 | ✅ |
| `memory-config` | 记忆插件配置 | 低 | ✅ |
| `memory` | 长期记忆（MEMORY.md / workspaces / hub / handoff / semantic） | 低 | ✅ |
| `skills` | 全部技能 | 低 | ✅ |
| `task-board` | 待办账本 | 中 | ✅ |
| `sync-config` | config-manager 的顶层 `*.json` | 中 | ✅ |
| `storages` | 含 `schedule.json` 定时任务 | 中 | ✅ |
| `sessions` | 会话记录（载荷主要来源，约 12 MB） | 高 | ✅ |
| `profiles` | 插件本体与依赖树（GB 级） | 高 | ❌ |

勾选结果空数组 = **用默认集合**（除 `profiles` 外全选）。界面里「一个都不选」是不可达状态——载荷不能为空。

---

## 场景五：不用改一行 YAML

**适合谁**：不想碰配置文件的人。

配置是**分层解析**的，优先级从高到低：

| 位置 | 谁来写 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-sync-backup/config.json` | 设置页 | **本机覆盖**，保存即生效，不用重启 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 你 | **出厂默认**，加载时读一次，改了要重启 |
| schema 默认值 | 代码 | 兜底 |

设置页里改的任何值都写进 `config.json`。**想整体回到出厂状态，删掉那个文件即可，不用重装。**

> 所以文档里写「默认值」时，务必说清是哪一层的默认值——本插件的 README 一律标出「schema 默认 / patch 出厂值」。

---

## 场景六：出事之前的最后一次确认（恢复自检）

**适合谁**：想让「备份成功」这四个字更可信的人。

两种自检：

- **每次打包后自动自检**（`restoreCheck`，默认关）：解密 → 解 tar → 逐条比 SHA256 与 manifest，**纯内存**，不写盘；
- **维护页的「运行恢复前自检」**：解到系统临时目录做真实解包校验，**验完立刻删除**，绝不覆盖 `$DSH_HOME` 里任何现有文件。

自检失败会把本次运行判为未通过，并单独置一个 `restoreCheckFailed` 健康位（不会被混进普通错误里被忽略）。

> ⚠️ **自检通过 ≠ 灾难恢复演练完毕。** 本插件**没有**一键恢复到 `$DSH_HOME` 的写回功能（这是刻意的安全取舍）。真正的手动恢复是：找回恢复码 → 解密归档 → 自己解包。详见[详细功能说明](README-详细说明.md)「已知局限」。

---

## 场景七：磁盘不会无限膨胀

**适合谁**：长期开着定时备份的人。

- **本地**：产物保留 `localKeepDays` 天（默认 7），另受 `keepLast` 份数约束；产物文件页有「立即清理」，清理前可以先在「环境和维护」页看实际占用；
- **远端**：按 `keepLast`（默认 7）逐通道裁剪。

**清理与备份是串行的**：清理、恢复自检都会去拿和备份同一把运行锁，备份进行中会被明确拒绝（`busy`），而不会「删着读」。

> 顺序契约：**先写归档与 manifest → 再写稳定副本 → 最后写索引 → 索引写成功后才 best-effort 删旧**。反过来先删后写会留下指向已删对象的悬空索引；中途崩溃至多留下无引用的孤儿文件，下一轮清理自动收掉。

---

## 场景八：随时知道「上次到底成没成」

**适合谁**：要一个一眼结论的人。

- **AI 侧**：`sync_backup_status` 返回结构化状态 + 人可读文本；
- **面板侧**：概览页顶部一条**健康条**，单一结论——`attention`（半失败达阈值）> `fail` > `partial` > `running` > `never` > `ok`。

会告诉你：上次运行时间与耗时、载荷文件数与体积、压缩率、各通道上次上传的 id / SHA256 前 16 位 / 保留份数、下次计划运行时刻、半失败连续轮数、以及**数据将发往哪里**（含从 config-manager 继承来的目标，界面上不显示口令，只显示配没配）。

---

## 还有这些能力（一句话索引）

- **加密默认开启**：归档落盘或出网前一律走 AES-256-GCM，明文从不写进磁盘；密钥采用**信封加密**（DEK 只以密文存在，由宿主凭据库保管的本机 KEK 与恢复码派生的 KEK 分别包裹）；
- **恢复码派生恢复 KEK**（base32 编码），**不落盘、无法事后重算**；面板只显掩码，点导出要过二次确认，明文 60 秒自动隐藏、离开页签即清空；首次生成/迁移时必须一次性抄走；
- **产物文件页**：本地加密归档列表（文件名 / 体积 / 时间）+ 远端副本摘要 + 立即清理；
- **通道配置页**：改「数据发往哪里」必须二次确认；开关从关变开也要确认（反向不拦）；
- **环境页**：逐条目本机体积统计、运行环境事实、备份集合的保存与恢复默认、**只读版本检查**（本机版本 / 远端最新 Release + 失败红字原因）；
- **零第三方 npm 依赖**：只用 Node 内置模块；声明的两个 peerDependencies 由 harness 提供；
- **可访问性**：页签支持 ←/→/Home/End 键盘导航、roving tabindex、`aria-controls` ↔ `tabpanel`，确认框支持 Escape 取消。

---

## 发布版本

版本号采用 **「主线号 + 推送日期」** 格式：`V<主>.<次>-<YYMMDD>`。

| 示例 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `V1.0-261008` | 初版（V1.0），2026-10-08 推送 |
| `V1.2-261011` | 第 2 次迭代，2026-10-11 推送 |
| `V1.3-261011` | 第 3 次迭代，2026-10-11 推送 |
| `V1.4-261011` | 第 4 次迭代，2026-10-11 推送 |
| `V1.5-261011` | 第 5 次迭代，2026-10-11 推送（P0 修复：启动竞态） |

- **主版本号**（`V1`）：重大架构变化时递增；
- **次版本号**（`.0` / `.1` / `.2`）：**每次迭代十进制递增**；
- **日期**（`261008`）：该次发布的**推送日期**（`YYMMDD`）。

`package.json` 的 `version` 保持 npm 合法的 semver 形式（`V1.5-261011` ↔ `1.5.0`），日期只体现在 **git tag** 与 Release 上。

**发版流程（开发者）**：

```sh
# 1. 提交并推送 main（tag 必须打在已推送的 main 提交上）
git push origin main

# 2. 打 annotated tag 并推送

git push origin V1.5-261011

# 3. 在 GitHub 建 Release，上传按版本打包的 zip 作为 Asset
```

```sh
git clone --depth 1 --branch V1.0-261008 https://g

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-liang-calibrator

**滑动变祖器 31 档** —— 把 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 输入框里的「模型选择 + 推理等级」控件，换成一台物理课本里的**滑动变阻器**。

拖滑片 = 同时切换模型与思考强度；滑动时对应档位的形象图会铺在 DSH 背景上，**停手 5 秒后自动淡出**。
档位图可以逐档换成本机自定义图片，31 档的名字也都能改。

[![CI](https://github.com/TerryYu12/dsh-liang-calibrator/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/TerryYu12/dsh-liang-calibrator/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

![折叠态](docs/01-collapsed.png)

---

## 界面

### 1. 折叠态：直接写清当前路由

输入框里只占一个小胶囊，显示 **提供商 · 模型 · 思考强度**（过长省略，悬停看完整内容）。
模型目录还没就绪、或会话被锁定时，旁边会直接说明原因并给出「重试」。

### 2. 点三角展开：滑动变阻器

铜线密绕瓷管 + 金属导轨 + 端板接线柱（C/D）+ 瓷管两端红色接线柱（A/B）+ 压板楔子滑片，
左侧到滑片的那段铜线微微发亮表示"接入电路"的长度。

![展开面板](docs/02-panel.png)

第一行是**模型名**（最大最亮），右侧是「梁名 + 带符号分值」，第二行是 `提供商 · 思考强度`。
点面板外、按 `Esc`、或点右上角 `✕` 都能收起。

### 3. 设置：四页 —— 路由 / 名字 / 背图

![按状态设置](docs/03-settings-stage.png)

![按档位设置](docs/04-settings-frame.png)

![名字设置](docs/06-settings-names.png)

![背图设置](docs/07-settings-images.png)

- **按状态 6**：小难梁 / 牢梁 / 梁子 / 梁圣 / 梁神 / 梁祖，各一条路由，整段生效；
- **按档位 31**：`-15` … `00` … `+15` 逐档一行，只覆盖你想改的那一档；
- **名字 31**：给 31 档各起一个名字；**相邻档位写成同一个名字就合并成一段**（跨段同名不合并），
  滑杆下方的站名行跟着变；留空用默认梁名；
- **背图 31**：31 档各可指定一张自定义图片，滑动到该档时铺满窗口；留空用内置档位图，
  同一张图给多个档位只存一份；
- 路由三列**都能手填**（provider / 模型 id / 思考强度），带自动补全但允许任意值 —— 接自己的 API 直接写进去即可；
- 灰色占位符显示**自动分档会选什么**，所以不改也能一眼看出每档接的是哪条路由；
- 优先级：**逐档 > 按状态 > 自动**；provider 不在当前目录时整行描琥珀色提示（仍会提交，由平台裁决）；
- 右上角一键清空，按钮随页变：**全部自动 / 全部默认 / 全部内置**；设置只存在本机浏览器。

### 4. 滑动时的背景：不影响你原来的壁纸

![背景效果](docs/05-background.png)

档位图只做**临时叠加**：

- 这一张图默认是内置档位图，也可以是你给这一档指定过的**自定义图**（见上节「背图 31」）；
- 它挂在 `body` 的第一个子节点、`z-index: -1`，位置在**你原来的壁纸之上、DSH 界面之下**；
- 显示期间把控件到 `body` 之间的面板**临时置为透明**，配合图层自带的压暗层保证文字可读；
- **停手 5 秒后自动淡出**（淡出 320ms），随后**原样还原**所有被改过的样式；
- 不修改、不替换你设置的壁纸，也不写入任何持久状态 —— 关掉插件后界面与原来完全一致。

### 5. 模型不可用的自救

会话当前选择的模型如果不在可用目录里，DSH 会在发送时拒绝：`session/model-unavailable: Select an available model before sending a message.`
这种状态**不会自己恢复**，所以插件做了四道防线（其中两条是 0.9.3 补的）：

- **提交前校验可用性**：手填的 provider / 模型必须**当前真的在目录里**。给某几档指定过 `cmd`，
  之后那个 provider 因为改端点、丢密钥而公布不出模型时，插件**不会再把它写进会话**，而是就地提示
  「`cmd` 当前不可用：no API key for provider route "cmd"」。手填自建 API 的场景（目录里暂时还没有
  这个 provider）默认同样拦下，但给一个 **「仍要使用」** 显式放行。
- **提交前校验等级**：目录里查得到该模型时，显式等级必须是它公布的之一。手填了不存在的等级
  （例如目录只有 `off/low/high/max`、你写了 `medium`）不会写进会话，而是提示可选值。
- **自动档位默认优先 `deepseek-account`**：同一个模型 id（如 `deepseek-flash`）往往同时被
  `deepseek-official`（需要 API Key）与 `deepseek-account`（登录即用）公布，而"目录里有"≠"请求能成功"
  —— 没配密钥的 api-key provider 照常公布模型，请求时才报
  `MISSING_CREDENTIAL: no API key for provider route "deepseek-official"`。
  客户端拿不到"某 provider 是否配了密钥"这个信号（宿主侧 `hasProviderApiKey` 没有 Remote 暴露），
  所以插件跟 **DSH 自己的规则**对齐：**没配 API Key 时用 `deepseek-account`**
  （对应宿主的 `initializeDefaultModel`）。设置里可关闭该开关，改为沿用你当前所在的 provider。
- **不可用提示 + 一键修回**：宿主明确回报当前选择不可用时（目录里 `routable === false`），
  输入框旁边出现红字 **「当前模型不可用」**（带上宿主给的失败原因）和 **「修回可用档位」** 按钮：
  点一下会清掉挡在这条路由上的本机设置（逐档 + 该档所属状态），跳到最近一条确实可提交的档位并提交。

> 事故记录：本插件踩过两个连着的坑 —— ① 把某几档指到 `cmd` 后，那个 provider 一度公布不出模型，
> 插件照样写进会话，于是之后每次发送都被 `session/model-unavailable` 拒绝；② `deepseek-flash`
> 同时挂在 `deepseek-official`（没配密钥）与 `deepseek-account` 两组下，梯子取了排在前面的 official，
> 滑动时把本来能用的 account 路由悄悄换掉，下次发送就报 `MISSING_CREDENTIAL`。
> 上面四道防线（其中两条是 0.9.3 补的）就是照着这两个场景补的。

### 本机数据都存哪

- 路由设置：`localStorage` 的 `liang-calibrator:stages`；
- 名字：`localStorage` 的 `liang-calibrator:names`（31 项，读入时去首尾空格、截 24 字符）；
- 背图：图片先压到长边 ≤ 1920 的 WebP，按内容哈希存进 **IndexedDB**（库 `liang-calibrator` / store `images`）；
  档位 → 图片 的映射在 `localStorage` 的 `liang-calibrator:images`；不再被任何档位引用的图片会自动回收；
- 排查现场：最近 8 条插件错误落在 `localStorage` 的 `liang-calibrator:errors`；
- 以上都只在本机浏览器里，不上传、不随插件分发。

---

## 档位语义

31 档由 `buildLadder()` **按当前模型目录动态生成**：

1. **模型分档**：按 `MODEL_TIERS` 顺序（由弱到强）把六个状态带平均切给目录里**实际存在**的模型。
   某个 provider 没配置或掉线时它的段会被跳过，帧区间自动重新平均给剩下的模型 —— 梯子只会变短，
   滑杆不会失效。改顺序或增删模型只改 `MODEL_TIERS` 一个数组。
2. **思考强度**：每个模型覆盖的那段帧，按该模型在目录里公布的等级**均分**，从弱到强单调递增；
   模型明确不提供等级时（例如 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 对没声明 `reasoningEfforts` 的模型返回 `reasoning: false`），
   这一段只提交模型本身，**不带 `reasoningEffort`**。

本机 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`、三个模型都在时（flash / pro 各有 `off/low/high/max`，cmd 不分等级）：

| 帧 index | 分值 | 状态 | 模型 | 思考强度 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0-4 | -15..-11 | 小难梁 | deepseek-flash | off |
| 5-8 | -10..-7 | 小难梁/牢梁 | deepseek-flash | low |
| 9-13 | -6..-2 | 牢梁/梁子 | deepseek-flash | high |
| 14-17 | -1..+2 | 梁子 | deepseek-flash | max |
| 18-23 | +3..+8 | 梁圣 | `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash`（cmd） | 不设置 |
| 24-25 | +9..+10 | 梁神 | deepseek-v4-pro | off |
| 26-27 | +11..+12 | 梁神 | deepseek-v4-pro | low |
| 28-29 | +13..+14 | 梁神 | deepseek-v4-pro | high |
| 30 | +15 | 梁祖 | deepseek-v4-pro | max |

同一组合占据连续若干档：**区间内拖动只换画面、不重复发请求**；外部改变模型（`/model` 命令、设置页）时，
滑杆会回位到对应区间的代表档位。当前选择不在梯子上时，芯片回退显示真实路由，滑杆仍可跳到任意档位。

名字（31 档可改名、相邻同名合并成段）与背图（逐档自定义）都只是**显示层**，不改变上面这张映射表。

---

## 安装

```sh
# 从 Release 安装
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/TerryYu12/dsh-liang-calibrator/releases/latest/download/dsh-liang-calibrator-0.9.3.tgz

# 或本地 tarball
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /path/to/dsh-liang-calibrator-0.9.3.tgz
```

`<profile>` 是你要装的 profile（通常是 `desktop`；用 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add …`）。
装好后 DSH 会把这个 bundle 追加进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，客户端半部由 `dsh-client-modules`
作为 `/plugins/dsh-liang-calibrator/client.js` 提供。多数情况下无需重启即会热挂载；
若界面没变化，刷新页面或重启 Harness。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-liang-calibrator
```

---

## 从源码构建 / 测试 / 截图

```sh
npm install
node scripts/fetch-frames.mjs   # 可选：素材缺失时从上游补抓（仓库里已带）
npm run build                   # 生成 lib/index.js 与 lib/client.js（内嵌 31 帧，约 2 MB）
node verify-levels.mjs          # 31 档 / 6 状态边界与梯子生成、名字分段与背图映射的纯逻辑
node render-test.mjs            # jsdom + React 真渲染：21 个场景
node tools/screenshot.mjs       # 重新生成 docs/ 里的 7 张界面截图（需要本机 Chrome/Edge）
npm pack
```

`render-test.mjs` 覆盖的 21 个场景包括：档位提交、段内不重复提交、目录未就绪与自愈重试、
锁定态、错误边界、背景图 5 秒淡出、注入面绝不抛错、折叠/展开/关闭、按状态与按档位两层设置、
逐档改名与同名合并、全梯同名、逐档自定义背图（含清除回退）、名字过多时站名行自动省略。

> 实现上有三条**不能破坏**的约束，改动前请先读 README 的对应注释：
> ① 客户端 `inject` 必须包含 `remote` / `remote.session`（Cordis 服务代理把 `this.ctx` 绑到调用方，
> `directoryFor()` 内部会读它，漏了目录永远取不到）；② 目录加载不能依赖注入函数的引用（否则渲染循环）；
> ③ 插槽注入面绝不能抛异常（会被渲染器把整个入口退役，界面静默退回官方控件）。

---

## 素材与授权

本插件是对 [Lichtspektrum/liang-intensity-calibrator](https://github.com/Lichtspektrum/liang-intensity-calibrator)
（滑动变祖器）的 DSH 化改造；控件结构参考了 [HansLin911/dsh-liang-slider](https://github.com/HansLin911/dsh-liang-slider)（MIT-0）。

`assets/frame-00..30.webp` 取自上游仓库的 `public/frames/`。依照上游仓库的处理方式，这些素材**随仓库分发**，
但——正如上游 README 所述——**素材不随 MIT 协议共享**：

> `media` 与 `public/frames` 里的人像素材用于趣味演示，**素材不随 MIT 协议共享**。
> 复用或二次发布前，请确认你拥有相关肖像与素材的使用权。

本项目维护者不拥有这些图像中人物的肖像权，也不通过本项目授予任何与肖像、姓名、身份、公开权、隐私权、
商标、版权或其他第三方权利有关的许可。若需商业使用、再分发或制作衍生版本，请自行确认所在司法管辖区的
适用法律、素材来源及所需授权。如你是相关权利人并希望移除素材，请提 Issue 联系。

## 许可证

**代码**以 [MIT-0](LICENSE) 发布（不含 `assets/` 中的第三方图像素材，见上节）。

plugins.description: Windows desktop automation for DeepSeek Harness: UI Automation, screenshots, scoped actions and native permissions.
plugins.readme_text:
# Desktop Tools for DeepSeek Harness

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) · [Security](SECURITY.md)

Native **Windows desktop automation** for DSH agents, using UI Automation (UIA) where possible and scoped screenshot coordinates when applications do not expose semantic controls.

## Features

- Five tools for window discovery, accessibility/control snapshots, screenshots, clicking, and typing.
- Per-session/window references and screenshot references prevent stale-coordinate reuse.
- Honors the **current DSH session permission preset**, plugin write toggle, per-process policy, and native approvals.
- Optional visible operation indicators; supports a PowerShell-based helper instead of a continuously running service.
- Automatically prunes eligible **plugin-owned screenshots** after the configured retention period, without deleting audit logs or active-session artifacts.

## Requirements and install

**Windows only.** Requires PowerShell 7, a compatible DSH host, and the dependencies described in [package.json](package.json). UIA or keyboard interaction requires an unlocked interactive desktop.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Kerberos255/dsh-desktop-tools
```

Use your actual DSH profile name if different. Pin a commit for reproducible installations and restart DSH after installing/updating plugin code.

## Quick start

1. Open **Settings → Plugins → Desktop Tools**. Review the allowed-process policy and leave writing disabled until needed.
2. Call `desktop_windows` to find a window, then `desktop_snapshot` to obtain current control references.
3. Use `desktop_click` or `desktop_type` with a current reference. Refresh the snapshot after changes.
4. For custom-drawn apps, use `desktop_screenshot` and its `screenshotRef`; coordinates are **inside that screenshot**, not global screen coordinates.

## Permissions and privacy

Read-only sessions cannot write. Full-access DSH sessions may avoid *repeated approvals for ordinary permitted interaction*, but explicitly forbidden processes, secure desktops, credential windows, and sensitive submissions remain protected. An approval setting that disables prompts is **not** a grant of permission.

Credential fields are suppressed in supported snapshots/screenshots. Audit files and screenshots are stored only in the local runtime directory. Screenshot cleanup defaults to seven days; active sessions and audit records are excluded. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and [policy.json](policy.json).

## Tests

Run `npm test` for portable security/policy checks. True UIA, DPI, focus, keyboard and on-screen marker tests require an **unlocked Windows host** and cannot be inferred from GitHub Actions alone. Settings template: [config.example.json](config.example.json).

Related: [Browser Tools](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-browser-tools) for web pages.

MIT licensed. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

## Optional plugin diagnostics

The plugin optionally emits privacy-restricted operation and failure metadata to dsh-plugin-diagnostics. Diagnostics contain event type, status, fixed error code and elapsed time; conversation content and credentials are not logged. The diagnostics plugin is optional and does not change the host requirements.

plugins.description: Per-workspace trust for DSH, used by other plugins to decide whether project code may run · 为 DSH 工作区记录信任，供其他插件决定是否运行项目里的代码
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-workspace-trust

给 DSH 工作区记录「信任 / 不信任」，供其他插件决定是否运行项目里的代码、能否访问工作区外的路径。

DSH 自带的没有工作区信任：克隆来的仓库里配了什么，插件就照着运行什么。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:RicardoYan/dsh-workspace-trust#v0.2.1
```

Web 端把 `desktop` 换成你的 profile 名（一般是 `web`）。装完重启 DSH。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-workspace-trust`

## 使用

- 每个工作区第一次开会话时弹一次：**信任** / **不信任**，选完记住，不再问
- 工作区 = 从会话目录往上最近的含 `.dsh/settings.yml` 或 `.git` 的目录；都没有就是会话目录本身。同一工作区的子目录共用一个选择
- `/workspace-trust` 查看状态；`/workspace-trust trust` 或 `untrust` 修改，当前会话立即生效
- 记录在 `~/.dsh/workspace-trust/workspaces.json`，按路径保存；删除工作区目录不会清掉记录。之后同一路径放了别的项目（例如重新克隆了另一个仓库），会沿用原来的选择，必要时用 `/workspace-trust untrust` 改回

## 禁止访问列表

以下目录即使工作区已信任也不允许插件读取：`~/.dsh ~/.ssh ~/.gnupg ~/.aws ~/.azure ~/.kube ~/.docker ~/.git-credentials ~/.config/gh ~/.netrc ~/.npmrc ~/.pypirc ~/.claude ~/.codex ~/.cc-switch`。在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里调整：

```yaml
- id: dsh-workspace-trust
  name: 'dsh-workspace-trust'
  config:
    deniedPaths: ['~/.my-secrets', '%APPDATA%/some-tool']   # 追加
    useDefaultDeniedPaths: true                             # false = 不用上面的默认列表
```

## 注意

- 本插件只记录和检查，本身不运行项目代码；哪些功能受信任控制，由使用它的插件决定
- 依赖 DSH 的 `agent/pre-step`、`userQuestions`、`commands` 接口，适用于 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`
- 没有界面（如 headless）时不弹询问，按未信任处理。关闭插件用 DSH 插件管理页的开关（会往 profile patch 写 `disabled`），插件没有自己的开关
- 禁止访问列表在插件详情页里配（`deniedPaths` / `useDefaultDeniedPaths`），也能手写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`
- 界面文字跟随 DSH 的语言设置（设置 → 常规 → 语言），只显示中文或英文；语言设为自动时跟随系统语言。斜杠命令列表里的命令说明在 DSH 启动时确定，切换语言后重启才更新

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: Lay out brochures, catalogs, and long documents, then export PDF, IDML, EPUB, or images.
plugins.readme_text:
# DesignCraft Use

## Plugin marketplaces

This plugin belongs to **AIGC content creation**.

| Category | Marketplace | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Full-stack development | [Full Stack Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-stack-plugins) | Architecture and UI design, code understanding, quality checks, code review, workflow governance, and server operations |
| AIGC content creation | [Full AIGC Plugins](https://github.com/partme-ai/full-aigc-plugins) | Image, video, audio, music, 3D, and multimodal content creation |

![DesignCraft Use — page layout and publishing](assets/official-logo.png)

> Lay out brochures, catalogs, newsletters, posters and long documents as editable `.designcraft` projects, then export PDF, IDML, EPUB or images after a print preflight.

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-0.1.0--dev.20261019.1-1A73E8)](.codex-plugin/plugin.json)
[![Skills](https://img.shields.io/badge/skills-16-00A67E)](#skills)
[![MCP server](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP%20server-1-00A67E)](#mcp-tools)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache--2.0-green)](LICENSE)

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Install](#installation) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [What you can build](#what-you-can-build) · [Skills](#skills) · [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)

## Positioning

DesignCraft Use turns content and assets into an editable page-layout project instead of a flattened mockup. It plans pages, runs the pinned native layout CLI through a small command catalogue, keeps text frames, image frames and linked assets addressable, and only calls a delivery done after the project has been saved, reopened in a new session and reviewed page by page.

It is a development candidate: static package checks and CI pass, while native installation, target-platform acceptance, current host discovery and creative acceptance are all still `NOT_RUN` across `support-matrix.json` and `project-status.json`.

| 16 skills | 1 editor server | 4 export formats | macOS arm64 |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| 6 atomic + 10 local | `designcraft-editor` | PDF, IDML, EPUB, images | Only verified platform |

## Status and version

`0.1.0-dev.20261019.1` · development preview · `docs/verification/release-candidate.json` → `releaseStatus: BLOCKED`, `installableDevelopmentCandidate: true`.

## Installation

### Prerequisites

- macOS arm64 for native execution, with Python 3.11 or newer on `PATH`.
- Node.js 24 or newer when you want the embedded editor MCP server.
- A marketplace install is self-contained. A Git checkout has no `ui/dist/`; build it first with `node build.mjs` and `python3 build-source.py` (Rust `wasm32` target and a matching `wasm-bindgen` are required; the build script installs nothing).
- The native CLI is downloaded into the user data directory on first authorized use; no `sudo` and no `PATH` changes.

### Install the plugin

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add full-aigc-plugins/designcraft-plugin
codex plugin add designcraft@full-aigc-plugins-designcraft
```

`docs/verification/release-candidate.json` records `installableDevelopmentCandidate: true` together with `releaseStatus: BLOCKED`; production promotion and all-host UI acceptance are not claimed.

Manifests for Codex (`.codex-plugin/`), Claude Code (`.claude-plugin/`), ZCode (`.zcode-plugin/`) and Kimi (`kimi.plugin.json`) are present, but host discovery for this candidate is recorded as `NOT_RUN`.

## Quick start

```bash
: "${SKILL_DIR:?Set to the directory holding the loaded designcraft-use SKILL.md}"
python3 -I -B "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/cli.py" -- commands
```

Ask for the work you actually want, for example *“Lay out a two-page product brochure from these images and export a print-ready PDF”*. The entry skill clarifies pages, size, assets, output path and revision scope before it plans anything.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A[Goal, outline, assets] --> B[designcraft-use clarifies scope]
    B --> C[Read the real command catalogue]
    C --> D[Native layout plan on a working copy]
    D --> E[Save and reopen .designcraft]
    E --> F[Page-by-page review, export, format-loss notes]
```

Repository self-checks (no native runtime needed):

```bash
python3 -I -B scripts/validate_package.py
python3 -I -B -m unittest discover -s tests
```

## What you can build

| Workflow | Built-in path | Verifiable output |
|:---|:---|:---|
| Multi-page brochure | `designcraft-brochure` → `designcraft-cli-layout` | Reopened project whose page count, text and linked images are checked |
| Catalog with uniform product layout | `designcraft-catalog` | Reopened catalog with consistent product frames and typography |
| Newsletter or multi-column publication | `designcraft-newsletter` | Reopened multi-column document with verified column flow |
| Poster with a clear information hierarchy | `designcraft-poster-layout` | Large-format project and reviewed export |
| Long document with TOC and page numbers | `designcraft-long-document` | Reopened document with sections, TOC and page numbering |
| Print preflight | `designcraft-print-preflight` | Fonts, images, bleed and export checks recorded before delivery |
| Badges from CSV records | `designcraft-data-merge-badges` | Per-record previews and a reopened project with complete fields |
| Edit in the embedded editor | `designcraft-editor` MCP tools | Saved project reopened and inspected in a new session |

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|:---|:---|
| `designcraft-use` | Default entry for new documents and page design; clarifies missing input first |
| `designcraft-cli` | Query and run native designcraft commands with real parameters |
| `designcraft-cli-setup` | First install, digest verification, version checks and failure triage |
| `designcraft-cli-document` | One lifecycle action on an existing project: open, save, save-as, reopen |
| `designcraft-cli-layout` | Query and drive text frames, image frames and page layout |
| `designcraft-cli-export` | Export a project to PDF, images, IDML or EPUB |
| `designcraft-brochure` | Multi-page product brochure from asset review to editable delivery |
| `designcraft-catalog` | Product catalog with uniform layout across many records |
| `designcraft-newsletter` | Multi-column newsletters and briefings |
| `designcraft-poster-layout` | Event poster hierarchy and large-format output |
| `designcraft-long-document` | Chapters, table of contents, page numbers and shared styles |
| `designcraft-print-preflight` | Font, image, bleed and export checks before print |
| `designcraft-data-merge-badges` | CSV-driven badges and name cards with per-record previews |
| `designcraft-scenario-playbooks` | Step-by-step playbooks with real parameters for eight layout scenarios |
| `designcraft-editor` | Open the real editor UI in the host and keep one session for all edits |
| `designcraft-harness` | Cross-session task state, UNKNOWN reconciliation and delivery evidence |

## MCP tools

`mcp.json` declares one stdio server, `designcraft-editor`, started as `node ui/bootstrap.mjs` from the plugin root. It opens the bundled engine in the host and proxies the editor tool set.

| Tool | Purpose |
|:---|:---|
| `open_editor` | Open the editor for an absolute `workspace` path |
| `open_browser_editor` | Return an `editorUrl` for a host built-in browser |

# Status Cards for DeepSeek Harness

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) · [Security](SECURITY.md)

A **unified DSH status dashboard** with a compact session-edge panel. See session health, model/preset/permission state, channel connectivity, jobs, schedules, memory/compaction status, and optional provider usage.

## Features

- A read-only **Status Center** in plugin settings for session-scoped diagnostics and plugin health.
- A collapsible side panel showing **OpenCode Go usage windows** and **DeepSeek account/API balances** when those sources are configured.
- Discord/Feishu `/status` integration via [Channel Core](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-channel-core), scoped to the current bound conversation.
- Cached/on-demand provider requests, not a continuously running high-frequency quota poll.
- Keeps account credentials in the DSH host; the client receives bounded status/amount data.

## Install and setup

Requires the DSH session and plugin services declared in [package.json](package.json).

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Kerberos255/dsh-status-cards
```

Use your own profile as appropriate. Restart DSH when plugin code changes. Open **Settings → Plugins → Status Cards** and choose which available provider balances or cards should appear.

## What the UI shows

| Area | Information |
| --- | --- |
| Status Center | Current session, selected model/preset/permissions, channel, jobs, schedules, plugin status |
| Session-edge card | Configured usage and wallet sources, remaining windows and refresh status |
| Discord / Feishu | A privacy-scoped view of the **current bound session** only |

An unconfigured or unavailable provider is **not** displayed as a zero balance. Provider data may be cached, delayed, or unavailable. Only configured sources appear in the quota panel.

## Privacy and tests

Credentials/cookies/API keys stay on the Host. Remote chat channels do **not** receive machine paths, all-account balances, other sessions, or private memory/skill text through status. Data that is not available is marked unavailable rather than fabricated.

Run `npm test` for portable provider-cache, balance-formatting and status logic. Actual balances and channel delivery require live, authorized services. Configuration sample: [config.example.json](config.example.json).

Related: [Channel Core](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-channel-core) · [Lossless Context](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-lossless-context) · [Dream & Memory](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-memory-dreaming).

MIT licensed. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

## Optional plugin diagnostics

The plugin optionally emits privacy-restricted operation and failure metadata to dsh-plugin-diagnostics. Diagnostics contain event type, status, fixed error code and elapsed time; conversation content and credentials are not logged. The diagnostics plugin is optional and does not change the host requirements.

# dsh-rulefile-check — Rule pack self-check against the citation discipline and severity ceilings

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-rulefile-check?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-rulefile-check?ref=badge)

`dsh-rulefile-check` reads one rule pack — the pack header plus one row per rule — and checks that pack against the citation discipline its plugin family enforces: that every rule id is unique within the pack, that both basis fields are filled in, that no excerpt is shorter than the minimum length, that every source is written as an http(s) link, that a rule whose basis kind is `derived-from-principle` or `institutional-configuration` carries a severity, that the check kind is one the engine supports, and that the pack header declares its name, plugin and version.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-rulefile-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-rulefile-check'
```

## What it looks like

![Workflow diagram for dsh-rulefile-check: document → rule pack → findings.](docs/assets/dsh-rulefile-check-flow.svg)

*Workflow overview: document → rule pack → findings. The examples below use the real command surface.*



## What it answers

### Examples

The table below is the example set: the first row is the detailed walkthrough, the remaining rows are short cases.

#### Detailed output

**Tool** `rulefile_check`

**Input**

~~~json
{"rows":[{"规则编号":"XX-001"},{"规则编号":"XX-001"}]}
~~~
 
**Output**

~~~json
{
  "id": "dsh-rulefile-check.RF-001.de02f9e1",
  "ruleId": "RF-001",
  "severity": "warn",
  "locator": {
    "row": 2,
    "field": "ruleId"
  },
  "found": "第 2 行「ruleId」的值「XX-001」与第 1 行重复",
  "expected": "「ruleId」在材料内应唯一",
  "fix": "核对是否重复登记或抄错；本条只核对唯一性"
}
~~~

*Observed from `dsh-rulefile-check/tests/fixtures/RF-001/RF-001-unsafe.json`*

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| The same rule id appears on two rules in the pack. | `RF-001` reports the repeated id, because a duplicate makes `issue.id` point at two different rules and the hit can no longer be traced back. Comparison ignores whitespace. It can only see one pack at a time: it does not compare two packs with each other or look anything up in a register. |
| A rule carries only `document` and says nothing about the clause. | `RF-002` checks that at least one of the two basis fields is filled in, so a rule whose `document` is present passes. It does not judge whether the cited clause really exists or whether it relates to the rule. |
| The excerpt is a one-sentence description of the clause rather than a quotation. | `RF-003` requires the excerpt to exist and to be at least eight characters long. Length is necessary, not sufficient: a twenty-character description is still not a quotation, and this rule cannot tell the difference — it does not compare the excerpt against the original clause. |
| The source reads `某某网站` instead of a link. | `RF-004` reports it, because the source field has to look like an http(s) link. It checks the form only: it does not visit the link, does not tell you whether the link works, and does not tell you whether the page really contains the clause being cited. |
| A rule derived from a principle is filed as `error`. | `RF-005` confirms that a rule whose basis kind is `derived-from-principle` or `institutional-configuration` states a severity at all. Whether that severity actually respects the ceiling is enforced by the loader, which rejects such a pack outright with `strongest permitted severity`; this check only covers the field being present and cannot replace the loader. |
| The pack writes a `check.kind` the engine does not know — and does it declare its `packName` and `version`? | `RF-006` reports the unknown `check.kind`, because such a rule is silently not executed. Its list of supported kinds ships empty, since which kinds exist depends on the engine version, so an unconfigured pack puts that rule in `skipped` instead of passing it; it only compares against the list you supply. `RF-007` checks the header for `packName`, `plugin` and `version` together, because without them you cannot tell which plugin a pack belongs to, or which revision, when you swap it in. Neither rule verifies that the declared values match the plugin actually in use. |

## Standards it follows

This rule pack cites no public standard: every rule's basis is the plugin family's own self-imposed citation discipline, its engine contract and its pack contract, so the entries below name the family's internal contracts rather than any statute or national standard.

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 本插件家族的条款引用纪律（自定纪律，非国家标准） | 无编号（本规则库自定） | RF-001, RF-002, RF-003, RF-004, RF-005 |
| 本插件家族的检查引擎契约（自定纪律，非国家标准） | 无编号（本规则库自定） | RF-006 |
| 本插件家族的规则库契约（自定纪律，非国家标准） | 无编号（本规则库自定） | RF-007 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **规则库** (a rule pack) for the citation discipline this plugin family
enforces — that rule ids are unique, that every basis field is present, that an excerpt has real length, that a
source is a link, that a derived or locally configured basis carries a severity, that the check kind is one the
engine supports, and that the pack declares its name, plugin and version.

> ### ⚠️ This checks form, not content — and it says so
>
> **The discipline being checked is self-imposed, not a national standard.** "An excerpt must be a verbatim
> quotation" and "a principle-derived check may not be an `error`" are rules this plugin family enforces in
> `shared/ruleset.ts`; their basis is the general principle of intellectual honesty — never dress a description
> up as a quotation, never dress an inference up as a requirement — **not any statute or standard**. Every
> rule's `basis` says exactly that, which is why every rule here is `warn` or `info`.
>
> **It cannot tell whether a citation is apt.** It checks that fields are filled, that an excerpt is long
> enough, that a source *looks like* a link, and that a severity is stated. It will happily pass a rule that
> cites **a real but irrelevant clause** — that is the documented limit of a form check, and it is why
> automated checking never replaces a human read-through.
>
> Two rules deserve a note. `RF-003`'s floor of eight characters is the ledger-side echo of the load-time guard
> — but **length is necessary, not sufficient**: a twenty-character *description* is still not a quotation, and
> this plugin cannot tell the difference. And `RF-005` can only confirm a severity field is present: whether a
> severity actually respects the ceiling is enforced by the loader, which rejects a violating pack outright with
> `strongest permitted severity`. `RF-006`'s kind vocabulary ships **empty**, because which kinds an engine
> supports depends on the engine version — hard-coding this family's own list would mean editing this plugin
> every time the engine gains a kind.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. `engines.dsh` is declared as `>=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0` and is enforced by the host since 0.2.1 |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native` and `ptc`; for a whole rule pack use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `rulefile_check` tool. It reads one rule inventory — the pack header plus one row per rule —
applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RF-001` | rule ids are unique | warn | self-imposed discipline |
| `RF-002` | basis fields are present | warn | self-imposed discipline |
| `RF-003` | the excerpt has real length | warn | self-imposed discipline |
| `RF-004` | the source is a link | warn | self-imposed discipline |
| `RF-005` | a derived basis carries a severity | warn | self-im

# dsh-hazplan-check — HAZOP worksheet element completeness and deviation derivation consistency check

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-hazplan-check?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-hazplan-check?ref=badge)

`dsh-hazplan-check` reads one HAZOP worksheet — rows keyed by the sheet's own column names, in Chinese or English, plus an optional header naming the 分析对象 — and checks that same sheet's completeness and internal traceability: that every row fills the fields your template requires (`偏差` and `原因` by default), that each row records its `节点`, that `引导词` come from the standard's tables 1 and 2 or from the list the study declared beforehand, that each row shows which element its deviation came from, that `风险等级` come from your own risk vocabulary, that the sheet names its analysis subject, and that every `偏差` is literally the `工艺参数` read through its `引导词`; a check that cannot run for want of a column is reported in `skipped` rather than passing silently.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-hazplan-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-hazplan-check'
```

## What it looks like

![Workflow diagram for dsh-hazplan-check: document → rule pack → findings.](docs/assets/dsh-hazplan-check-flow.svg)

*Workflow overview: document → rule pack → findings. The examples below use the real command surface.*



## What it answers

### Examples

The table below is the example set: the first row is the detailed walkthrough, the remaining rows are short cases.

#### Detailed output

**Tool** `hazplan_check`

**Input**

~~~json
{"rows":[{"节点":"进料单元","工艺参数":"流量","引导词":"无","偏差":"无流量","原因":""}]}
~~~
 
**Output**

~~~json
{
  "id": "dsh-hazplan-check.HZ-001.de09b5a6",
  "ruleId": "HZ-001",
  "severity": "warn",
  "locator": {
    "row": 1
  },
  "found": "第 1 行缺少 原因",
  "expected": "每一个危险和可操作性问题都应作为单项记录，并与其原因一起记录；本机构配置的必填项为 偏差、原因",
  "fix": "补齐栏目；本条只核对是否填写，不判断该问题是否找全"
}
~~~

*Observed from `tests/fixtures/HZ-001/HZ-001-unsafe.json (cases.json expects HZ-001 count 1); run via lib/index.mjs rules/hazplan-check.yaml`*

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A row records the deviation but leaves the cause blank. Is that reported? | Yes. `HZ-001` requires the fields every row must fill; shipped unset, it falls back to the pair the clause itself names, `偏差` and `原因`, so a blank `原因` is a gap on its own. It checks that the column is filled, not that the problem list is complete or the cause technically sound. |
| Three rows carry no node at all. Does the check say anything, and does it judge how the nodes were divided? | `HZ-002` reports those rows together and lists their row numbers, because a record without nodes cannot produce the node list the clause asks for. It checks only that `节点` is filled; it does not judge whether the node granularity is right, since clause 4.2 gives no criterion for it, and it does not decide whether any node was left unanalysed. |
| Our study wrote 相逆 in the `引导词` column. Will that be flagged? | `HZ-003` reports it as a guide word outside the list: the standard's own wording is 「相反」, not 相逆, and tables 1 and 2 supply 无/多/少/伴随/部分/相反/异常 and 早/晚/先/后. The finding is a prompt rather than a verdict, because a guide word the study defined and archived before the analysis is permitted — which is why the rule sits at `warn`. A deployment can declare its own list instead, and then only words outside that list are reported. |
| The `偏差` column reads 无流量, while `工艺参数` says 温度 and `引导词` says 无. Is that caught? | `HZ-007` reports the row when the written `偏差` does not contain the `工艺参数` read through its `引导词` in either word order; blanks and the usual separators (for example `+`, `、`, `/`, `-`, `—`, `的`, `：`) are ignored, so 流量无, 流量 + 无 and 无流量 all agree. It runs only when all three columns are present — otherwise it appears in `skipped` — and a hit means a likely copy-paste artefact, not that the deviation is technically wrong. |
| The `风险等级` column is filled with 中, but we never configured a risk vocabulary. What comes back? | `HZ-005` reports itself in `skipped`, not as a pass: the standard fixes no risk-level scale, so the levels have to come from your own risk criteria and the shipped list is empty. Once levels are configured it only checks that the value is in the list, not whether the rating is correct, and its severity is capped at `info`. |
| The worksheet has no line naming the unit it analyses. Is that a gap? | `HZ-006` reports it once, at the top level: without an analysis subject the conclusions cannot be traced back to the boundary that was analysed. The header list it rests on comes from an informative appendix — a suggestion, not a requirement — so the rule stays at `warn`, and `requireHeader: false` turns it off for sheets that legitimately carry none. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《危险与可操作性分析（HAZOP分析）应用指南》 | GB/T 35320-2017 | HZ-001, HZ-002, HZ-003, HZ-004, HZ-005, HZ-006, HZ-007 |
| 《风险管理 风险评估技术》 | GB/T 27921-2023 | HZ-005 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks one **HAZOP worksheet** for what a sheet can be held to — that every row
records the analysis content your template requires, that each 偏差 actually follows from the 工艺参数 and
引导词 beside it, that risk levels come from your own vocabulary, that every node has rows, and that
recommendations carry their closure fields. It does **not** judge whether the causes are complete, whether
the consequences are analysed far enough, whether the safeguards are adequate, or whether a risk rating is
correct. **Those four judgements are the study team's, and they are where HAZOP's value lies.**

> ### ⚠️ Nothing here is `error`, and the clause wording is why
>
> **GB/T 35320-2017《危险与可操作性分析（HAZOP分析）应用指南》** is in force (published and effective
> 2017-12-29, identical to IEC 61882:2001), and its clause text was obtained verbatim.
>
> **The standard is a *recommended* one (the number carries "/T"), and every clause this pack cites uses
> 宜 — "should" — not 应.** That applies to the two clauses an earlier version of this pack rated as
> `error`: **6.6.4** reads 「每一个危险和可操作性性问题都**宜**作为单项记录」 and **6.6.3** opens
> 「HAZOP 分析输出**宜**包括：」. **A recommendation cannot support an error rating**, so both rules are
> now `warn` and **this plugin reports no error at all** — consistent with how the family treats every
> other recommended standard. A test pins this so a later edit cannot quietly re-escalate one.
>
> **Everything else is capped at `warn` or `info`, for three reasons the pack records:**
>
> 1. **Appendix A.2 — the one place a column list appears — is a 资料性附录.** Its wording is "表列的标题
>    **可为**以下各项", it adds "**也可记录**其他信息", and it says outright that "工作表的版面设计**各有不同**".
>    **There is no mandatory column list**, so a missing column can only ever be a suggestion.
> 2. **Clause 4.2 gives no criterion for node granularity.** It says the size of a node "取决于系统的
>    复杂性和危险的严重程度" and nothing quantitative follows. This plugin **does not** judge node size.
> 3. **The standard fixes no risk-level scale.** 6.5 mentions a risk matrix as useful and defers the method
>    to IEC 60300-3-9; GB/T 27921-2023's matrix description is likewise informative. Levels must come from
>    your own risk criteria, so the vocabulary ships **empty**.
>
> Two further honesty notes are in the pack. The guide-word vocabulary uses the standard's own wording —
> **「相反」, not the colloquial "相逆"** — and combines table 1 with table 2; a custom guide word is
> **not** non-compliant, because 6.4.3 permits one "只要在分析开始前进行了定义". And **SH/T 3240-2025**
> (the petrochemical HAZOP specification, in force 2025-11-01) had only its identity, status and glossary
> verified — **its clause text was not obtained, so this pack cites none of it**.
>
> The four judgements this plugin does not make: whether the causes are complete, whether the consequences
> are analy

# dsh-gongwen-flow-check — Official document circulation and handling deadline register check

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-gongwen-flow-check?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-gongwen-flow-check?ref=badge)

`dsh-gongwen-flow-check` reads one incoming-document register with its handling-step ledger — the document header plus one row per handling step — and checks that register’s own completeness and internal consistency: that every step names a handler in `handler`, that `receivedAt` and `doneAt` parse as dates and follow each other, that a completion falls inside the deadline the register itself records in `dueAt`, that each `status` comes from the vocabulary you configured, that `docNo` is registered only once, and that the header declares the document title and receipt date. It does not decide whether handling was late, whether it should be chased, or who is accountable.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-gongwen-flow-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-gongwen-flow-check'
```

## What it looks like

![Workflow diagram for dsh-gongwen-flow-check: document → rule pack → findings.](docs/assets/dsh-gongwen-flow-check-flow.svg)

*Workflow overview: document → rule pack → findings. The examples below use the real command surface.*



## What it answers

### Examples

The table below is the example set: the first row is the detailed walkthrough, the remaining rows are short cases.

#### Detailed output

**Tool** `gongwen_flow_check`

**Input**

~~~json
{"rows":[{"办理环节":"承办","收文日期":"2026-03-02","办结日期":"2026-02-28"}]}
~~~
 
**Output**

~~~json
{
  "id": "dsh-gongwen-flow-check.GF-002.de09b5a6",
  "ruleId": "GF-002",
  "severity": "warn",
  "locator": {
    "field": "receivedAt",
    "row": 1
  },
  "found": "第 1 行「receivedAt」为 2026-03-02，晚于 「doneAt」的 2026-02-28",
  "expected": "「receivedAt」不应晚于 2026-02-28",
  "fix": "办结日期不应早于收文日期；核对两个日期的填写"
}
~~~

*Observed from `tests/fixtures/GF-002/GF-002-unsafe.json (cases.json expects GF-002 count 1); run via lib/index.mjs rules/gongwen-flow-check.yaml`*

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A handling step has no handler filled in. What does the register get told? | `GF-001` requires the `handler` column on every step and reports the step where it is blank. It checks only that the column is filled in, not whether the handling was timely — it does not decide whether the step should have been chased or who is accountable. |
| The completion date is earlier than the receipt date. Is that caught? | Yes. `GF-002` parses `receivedAt` against `doneAt` and reports the step when the two dates do not follow each other. It compares the two dates written in the ledger only — the same day counts as not later — and does not judge whether the handling stayed inside its deadline. A date it cannot parse is reported separately rather than skipped in silence. |
| A row never records a handling deadline. Does the check assume one? | No. `GF-003` runs only when the register itself writes a deadline into `dueAt`; with `dueAt` empty the rule reports itself in `skipped`. The regulation fixes no number of days and the plugin hard-codes none, so no deadline is ever inferred. A hit means “this does not match the deadline you recorded”, not “this is overdue”. |
| The handling status is filled with a value that is not in the configured list. | `GF-004` reports the row when the `status` value is not among the values you configured in `values`. Shipped, that list is empty, which means unconfigured, so the rule reports itself in `skipped` instead of passing in silence. It checks only whether the value is on your list, not which stage the document is actually at. |
| The same document number appears twice in the register. | `GF-005` requires `docNo` to be unique in the register; whitespace is ignored when comparing. A hit usually means a duplicate registration or a mis-copied number, and needs a human to confirm: a repeated `docNo` leaves the reader unable to tell one document registered twice from two different documents carrying one number. |
| The register itself never declares the document title and receipt date. | `GF-006` requires the header to declare both `title` and `receivedAt` at the top level, and reports the header when either is missing. It checks only that the two are declared, not whether the title is in the correct form, and not whether the handling records really belong to that document. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《党政机关公文处理工作条例》 | 中办发〔2012〕14号（自 2012 年 7 月 1 日起施行） | GF-001, GF-002, GF-003, GF-004, GF-005, GF-006 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **收文登记与办理环节台账** for what a register can be held to
mechanically — that every step names its handler, that the receipt and completion dates parse and follow
each other, that a completion falls inside the deadline the register itself states, that statuses come from
your vocabulary, that document numbers are unique, and that the header identifies the document. It does
**not** decide whether handling was late, whether it should be chased, or who is accountable. The regulation
requires an urgent document to have **its handling deadline stated** and requires work to finish within a
stated deadline — **it fixes no number of days itself**, so the deadline always comes from the incoming
document or your own rules, and this plugin never invents one.

> ### ⚠️ What the citations in this plugin's report actually rest on
>
> **The regulation's full text has been obtained and checked.** 《党政机关公文处理工作条例》(中办发〔2012〕14号)
> was read verbatim from the central government portal, and `rules/evidence/clause-verification.md` records
> exactly which articles were quoted — article 5 (principles), article 24 (the seven receiving procedures,
> including 「紧急公文应当明确办理时限」) and article 42 (in force from 2012-07-01, superseding two earlier
> documents). That check **corrected this pack's own wording**: it previously said national rules contain only a
> general principle, when article 24 in fact requires an urgent document's deadline to be *stated*.
>
> **The rule `excerpt` fields still say "本次未取得", and every rule remains `warn` or `info`** — deliberately.
> What this plugin checks is whether *a register* is complete and self-consistent; the regulation governs how a
> document is *handled*, which is a different proposition. Labelling "this column is blank" as a `direct`
> citation of "handling shall be recorded in detail" would dress a register gap up as a breach of the regulation,
> which is exactly the over-claim this family exists to avoid. The check also leaves the deadline's size to the
> incoming document and the institution, as article 24 does.
>
> 《党政机关公文格式》(GB/T 9704-2012) **was not obtained**, and this plugin does not check layout in any case.
>
> The deadline rule deserves its own note. `GF-003` compares the completion date against the deadline
> **written in the register itself** (`dueAt`); with no deadline recorded it reports itself in `skipped`
> rather than assuming a number of days. Its finding says "this does not match the deadline you recorded",
> **not** "this is overdue" — lateness depends on reminders, extensions and the document's own urgency.

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. `engines.dsh` is declared as `>=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0` and is enforced by the host since 0.2.1 |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native` and `ptc`; for a year's register use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `gongwen_flow_check` tool. It reads one handling register — the document's header plus one row
per handling step — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.
