# dsh-artifact-stamp

给**文本产物**盖「时间戳 + 版本号」的**行内版本戳**，并提供一个可当 CI 关卡用的体检命令。

一句话：**给文档做一版手工简化的 git** —— 但戳写在文件**自己身上**，人眼一眼可见，机器也能解析。

## 为什么会有这个

当 agent 频繁改写 `.md`（笔记、技能、README、实验记录）时，会遇到一个问题：

- **git 不适合**：文档是持续追加的，每次改动都 commit 太重；而且看历史要跳出文件本身
- **不管也不行**：你打开一个文档，**不知道它什么时候写的、这一版改了什么、上一版长什么样**

所以约定一条：**每个文本产物的正文最前面，有一行可读、可解析的戳**。

```
> 🕒 v2 · 2026-10-10 08:50 · dsh-agent ｜ 变更：补实验结论 ｜ 上一版：v1 · 2026-10-10 08:48
```

> 🔴 **没有脚本守的约定一定会漂移。** 所以这条约定配了工具 + 体检命令：
> `check` 会比对「戳里的时间」与「文件 mtime」，**改过却没盖戳 → 退出码 1**。

## 装

本仓库根目录就是一个 **DSH 技能**，clone 后放进用户级技能根即可：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yanggaihao5-sys/dsh-artifact-stamp.git
cp -r dsh-artifact-stamp ~/.dsh/skills/artifact-stamp
```

Windows（PowerShell）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/yanggaihao5-sys/dsh-artifact-stamp.git
Copy-Item -Recurse dsh-artifact-stamp "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\artifact-stamp"
```

只用命令行也行（**纯标准库、无网络、可离线跑**）：

```bash
python scripts/artifact_stamp.py new  <file> --note "初稿"
python scripts/artifact_stamp.py bump <file> --note "补数据"
python scripts/artifact_stamp.py show <file>
python scripts/artifact_stamp.py check <路径...> [--days 30] [--include-code]
python scripts/artifact_stamp.py strip <路径...> --dry-run
```

| 子命令 | 干什么 |
|---|---|
| `new` | 新建时盖 v1（已有戳则不覆盖） |
| `bump` | 改完后升版 v1→v2；**note 没变就不升版**（除非 `--force`） |
| `show` | 看当前戳 |
| `check` | 体检：缺戳 / **改过没盖戳** / 戳过期；**退出码 1 = 有违规** |
| `strip` | 回滚：一键删掉所有戳行（`--dry-run` 先预览） |

## 实测演示

![实测输出](docs/demo.png)

> 上图是 `demo/` 里**真实跑出来的输出**的排版图（不是终端截屏；emoji 以文字替代）。

```
$ python scripts/artifact_stamp.py new demo/design.md --note "初稿：设计笔记"
stamped v1: demo/design.md

# 过了 95 秒后改了内容，但忘了盖戳：
$ python scripts/artifact_stamp.py check demo
  ✗ 改过没盖戳：文件 mtime=2026-10-10 08:50，戳=2026-10-10 08:48（v1）
      demo/design.md

统计：文本文件 1 · 有戳 1 · 缺戳 0 · 改过没盖戳 1 · 戳超过 30 天 0 · 非UTF8跳过 0 · PS无BOM 0
判定：有违规（退出码 1）。修复：`artifact_stamp.py new <file>` 或 `bump <file> --note "..."`

$ python scripts/artifact_stamp.py bump demo/design.md --note "补实验结论"
bumped: demo/design.md -> v2 @ 2026-10-10 08:50

$ python scripts/artifact_stamp.py check demo
统计：文本文件 1 · 有戳 1 · 缺戳 0 · 改过没盖戳 0 · 戳超过 30 天 0 · 非UTF8跳过 0 · PS无BOM 0
判定：全部合规 ✅
```

盖完的正文长这样：

```
> 🕒 v2 · 2026-10-10 08:50 · dsh-agent ｜ 变更：补实验结论 ｜ 上一版：v1 · 2026-10-10 08:48

# 设计笔记

第一版。

补了一段实验结论。
```

## 支持哪些文件类型

戳必须写成该文件类型合法的注释，否则会把源码写坏。已内建映射：

| 扩展名 | 前缀 |
|---|---|
| `.md` `.markdown` `.txt` `.rst` `.org` | `> ` |
| `.py` `.ps1` `.sh` `.yaml` `.toml` `.ini` `.r` `.jl` `.m` … | `# ` |
| `.js` `.ts` `.c` `.cpp` `.java` `.go` `.rs` … | `// ` |
| `.tex` `.bib` `.sty` `.cls` | `% ` |
| `.vbs` `.vba` `.bas` | `' ` |

**不认识的类型直接拒绝盖戳并报错**（而不是硬插一行把文件弄坏）。

## 🔴 已知限制（先说清楚）

1. **90 秒分辨率**：戳只有**分钟精度**，而 mtime 是秒精度。所以**盖戳后 90 秒内的改动 `check` 检测不到**（默认 `--tolerance 90` 就是为了吸收这个偏差）。
   ⚠️ **`--tolerance 0` 不是可用设置**——它会对每个刚盖过戳的文件都报漂移。想要更灵敏只能把戳精度改成秒。
2. **不是 git 的替代品**：它只记「**什么时候、改了什么（一句话）**」，**不存差异、不能回滚内容**。真正的版本控制仍然用 git。
3. **不改文件编码**：原文件带 UTF-8 BOM 就保留，没有就不加。**唯一例外**是给 `.ps1` 写进非 ASCII 时会自动补 BOM（Windows PowerShell 5.1 会把无 BOM 的脚本按 GBK 读 → 中文乱码/语法错）。
4. **保护 YAML frontmatter**：`SKILL.md` 这类带 `---` 头的文件，戳插在 frontmatter **之后**。
5. **保护 shebang**：`.py` 的 `#!` 与 PEP-263 编码行永远留在最前（早期版本曾把戳插到第 1 行，导致 `./x.py` 直接执行失效）。
6. **体检默认跳过** `.git` / `node_modules` / `__pycache__` / `backups` / `_归档`；默认不检查 `.json`（数据文件不该盖戳）。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: fixes dsh-ui table cells painting text over the next column, and wraps long cells instead of forcing a horizontal scrollbar.
plugins.readme_text:
# @adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh) plugin that repairs `dsh-ui` table rendering:

- **cells no longer paint their text over the next column** — the bug where a long run of inline-code chips bleeds across the column boundary;
- **long cells wrap** instead of stretching the table until it needs a horizontal scrollbar.

It applies to the shipped `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui` **0.11.x** and does not wait for an upstream release. Once upstream ships its own fix, this plugin stays harmless and can simply be removed.

## What it fixes

`dsh-ui` table cells default to `white-space: nowrap` (the plugin's deliberate "data columns do not fold" voice). Meanwhile the host shell renders message bodies inside a `.markdown` subtree, and two rules from that sheet land on `dsh-ui` output because the components render in the same subtree:

```css
.markdown { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }                 /* inherited by every cell */
.markdown :not(pre) > code { display: inline-flex; }   /* every chip becomes an atomic inline box */
```

Add the plugin's own `.inlineCode { white-space: pre-wrap }` and the chip's **automatic minimum size collapses**: the column may be sized below its own content, while the cell's `nowrap` still paints the text unbroken — straight over the neighbouring column.

Only cells containing inline code are affected. A pure-text cell is `nowrap`, so its min-content already equals its content width and the column can never be sized below it.

Measured on a live DSH desktop page (7 tables): on 0.11.4, 4 tables and 12 cells overflowed, the worst single cell by **704px**.

## The two rules it injects

```css
/* 1) Table chips must not re-open line breaking — this is the root cause. */
[class*="tableWrap"] table [class*="inlineCode"] { white-space: pre !important; }

/* 2) Single-line data cells wrap — long content no longer stretches the table. */
[class*="tableWrap"] table td:not([class*="tdMultiline"]):not([class*="tdCode"]),
[class*="tableWrap"] table th:not([class*="tdMultiline"]):not([class*="tdCode"]) {
  white-space: normal !important;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
```

The selectors use only **CSS Modules class-name prefixes** (`tableWrap`, `inlineCode`, `tdMultiline`, `tdCode`), never the build-time hash, so they survive plugin upgrades.

Rule 2 is a **preference**. Remove that block from `lib/client.js` if you would rather keep the upstream behaviour of a wider table plus horizontal scrolling.

## Geometry verification

The same browser fixture, in an 801px container:

| Styles | Table width | Horizontal scroll | Cross-column bleed |
|---|---|---|---|
| upstream 0.11.4 (unfixed) | 1471px | yes | **4 cells, worst 306px** |
| upstream `main` (fix #282) | 1777px | yes | none |
| **this plugin** | **799px** | **no** | **none** |

In other words: the upstream repair makes the table wider and asks you to scroll; this plugin lets the long content wrap, so the table fits the conversation column.

## Install

The plugin is an ordinary DSH bundle: a dependency in a profile, plus one entry in that profile's bundle list.

### From npm

1. Add it to the profile you want it in — `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`:

   ```json
   {
     "dependencies": {
       "@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix": "^0.1.0"
     },
     "dsh": {
       "profile": {
         "bundles": ["…", "@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix"]
       }
     }
   }
   ```

2. Install it:

   ```
   cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile> && pnpm install
   ```

3. **Restart the DSH app.** The host-side plugin tree is assembled when the process starts, so a running instance will not pick up a new bundle.

If pnpm refuses the freshly published version because of a minimum-release-age policy, add the package name to `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` in that profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`.

### From a local checkout

Use a `link:` path instead of the version, for example `"@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix": "link:/path/to/dsh-genui-bugfix"`, then run the same two steps.

## Verify

After a restart the renderer carries one extra stylesheet:

```js
document.getElementById('dsh-genui-bugfix/table-overflow')   // non-null once loaded
```

Visually: tables with long inline-code runs no longer print text over the next column, and their width matches the conversation column instead of scrolling.

Without DSH running you can still check both halves against the loader contract:

```
cd <plugin> && npm test
```

## Uninstall

1. Remove `@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix` from the profile's `dependencies` and `bundles`;
2. `pnpm install`;
3. restart DSH.

## Relation to the upstream fix

- Upstream `main` already fixes the overlap itself (PR [#282](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui/pull/282), not yet released). Rule 1 here has the same effect and coexists with it — both keep the chip at `white-space: pre`.
- The upstream browser fixture cannot catch that regression: its cross-column assertion is vacuously true because the fixture renders tables outside the host `.markdown` cascade. See issue [#285](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui/issues/285) and PR [#286](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui/pull/286).

## Layout

```
@adamcjm/dsh-genui-bugfix/
├── package.json        # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client declarations
├── cordis.patch.yml    # inserts one plugin row into the profile
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js        # host half: node ESM, exports name/apply/inject, no behaviour
│   └── client.js       # browser half: window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })
├── test/verify.mjs     # zero-dependency self-check of the loader contract
└── README.md
```

Both halves follow the shapes already used by shipped plugins:

- the **host** half is plain node ESM exporting `name` / `apply` / `inject` — the same shape as the host half of `dsh-window-drag-probe`, which also has no host-side behaviour;
- the **client** half must be the pre-bundled form DSH serves to the renderer, `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`, where `factory` returns the exports carrying `apply` — the same shape as the client artifacts of `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui` and `dsh-boot-animation`. A plain ESM `export function apply` is **not** loaded, and it fails silently rather than reporting an error. This plugin has no runtime dependencies, so its factory never needs `require`.

## License

# dsh-ohos-shell

本文件为双语对照，每节先中文，后英文。以下内容由两语共用，只出现一次：代码块、路径、命令、字段名、环境变量名、URL 与版本号。

This document is bilingual. Each section gives Chinese first, then English. These items are shared and appear once: code blocks, paths, commands, field names, environment variable names, URLs, and version numbers.

## 1 概述 / Overview

`dsh-ohos-shell` 是 deepseek-harness 的捆绑包（bundle）。它面向 HarmonyOS 与 OpenHarmony 设备，用于补齐子进程的运行环境。

`dsh-ohos-shell` is a bundle for deepseek-harness. It targets HarmonyOS and OpenHarmony devices. It completes the runtime environment of child processes.

本包只在 HarmonyOS 与 OpenHarmony 上生效。其它平台上两行 Host 插件拒绝运行，环境保持不变。

This package acts on HarmonyOS and OpenHarmony only. On every other platform both Host plugin rows refuse to run and the environment stays unchanged.

捆绑包向 profile 插入两行 Host 插件。

The bundle inserts two Host plugin rows into the profile.

| 行 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `ohos-shell-env` | 把运行环境写入主进程的 `process.env`，卸载时还原。 |
| `ohos-shell-facts` | 通过 `ctx.shellEnv` 发布同样的信息（`DSH_OHOS*`），供模型 shell 读取。 |

| Row | Function |
|---|---|
| `ohos-shell-env` | Writes the environment into the host process `process.env`. It restores the value at unload. |
| `ohos-shell-facts` | Publishes the same facts through `ctx.shellEnv` (`DSH_OHOS*`) for model shell calls. |

## 2 适用背景 / Background

鸿蒙不是普通的 Linux 主机。下面五项差异会影响 Harness 的子进程。

HarmonyOS is not a standard Linux host. Five differences below affect Harness child processes.

| 事实 | 后果 |
|---|---|
| `SHELL=/bin/sh`，而 `/bin/sh` 是 mksh（MirBSD Korn Shell） | mksh 读取 `${ENV:-~/.mkshrc}`。该文件不存在，因此它不读任何配置：没有别名、函数、补全与提示符。它既不是 bash，也不是 zsh。 |
| `/etc/shells` 不存在 | Harness 的 shell 发现没有注册表可查。 |
| `/tmp` 只读 | 必须有可写的 `TMPDIR`，否则 `os.tmpdir()` 返回 `/tmp`。 |
| 应用沙箱 uid（2000xxxx）不在 `/etc/passwd` 中 | Node 的 `os.userInfo()` 抛出 `uv_os_get_passwd ENOENT`。Node 命令行工具调用它时不加 `try`/`catch`。 |
| zsh 未随包发行函数库 | `fpath` 指向构建机，上游 281 个函数中只有 3 个存在，Harness 的 zsh 集成因此无法 autoload 所需函数。见 5.3 节。 |

| Fact | Consequence |
|---|---|
| `SHELL=/bin/sh`, and `/bin/sh` is mksh (MirBSD Korn Shell) | mksh reads `${ENV:-~/.mkshrc}`. That file does not exist, so mksh reads no configuration. It has no aliases, functions, completions, or prompt. It is not bash and not zsh. |
| `/etc/shells` does not exist | The Harness shell discovery has no registry to read. |
| `/tmp` is read-only | A writable `TMPDIR` is necessary. Without it, `os.tmpdir()` returns `/tmp`. |
| The app sandbox uid (2000xxxx) has no `/etc/passwd` entry | Node `os.userInfo()` throws `uv_os_get_passwd ENOENT`. Node command-line tools call it without a `try`/`catch`. |
| zsh ships without its function library | `fpath` points at the build machine. Only 3 of the 281 upstream functions exist, so the Harness zsh integration cannot autoload the functions it needs. See section 5.3. |

侧栏终端按下面的表达式解析 shell。`dsh-subprocess-local` 从 `process.env.SHELL` 取默认值。

The sidebar terminal resolves its shell with the expression below. `dsh-subprocess-local` reads the default value from `process.env.SHELL`.

```
subprocess.terminalEnvironment().defaultShell ?? '/bin/sh'
```

`terminal-controller` 行没有 `shell` 配置。侧栏打开的是 `/bin/sh -i`，也就是 mksh，它不读 rc。内置的 Settings → Shell 页面只改命令超时与输出上限，改不了这一项。

The `terminal-controller` row has no `shell` configuration. The sidebar opens `/bin/sh -i`, which is mksh, and mksh reads no rc file. The built-in Settings → Shell page changes only the command timeout and the output cap. It cannot change this value.

## 3 环境要求 / Requirements

运行前请确认以下条件：

Make sure that these conditions are true:

- 设备运行 HarmonyOS 或 OpenHarmony。这是硬条件：插件在激活时自行判定平台，其它平台上两行插件拒绝运行，各记录一条 `error`，环境保持不变。
- 已安装 harmonybrew，前缀默认为 `~/.harmonybrew`。
- 已通过 harmonybrew 安装 deepseek-harness。
- 系统提供 `/usr/bin/zsh`。

- The device runs HarmonyOS or OpenHarmony. This is a hard condition. Each plugin row decides the platform at activation. On every other platform both rows refuse to run, each one logs an `error`, and the environment stays unchanged.
- harmonybrew is installed. The default prefix is `~/.harmonybrew`.
- deepseek-harness is installed through harmonybrew.
- The system provides `/usr/bin/zsh`.

## 4 安装 / Installation

本包发布在 npm 上。请通过 Harness 的插件管理器安装，或在插件市场里搜索本包。

The package is published on npm. Install it through the Harness plugin manager, or search for it in the plugin market.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ohos-shell
```

插件管理器会完成两步：把包装入 profile，并把包名写入 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

The plugin manager completes two steps. It installs the package into the profile, and it writes the package name into `dsh.profile.bundles`.

安装后，profile 的 `package.json` 应包含下面的条目。

After the installation, the profile `package.json` contains the entries below.

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-ohos-shell": "^1.1.0"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["...", "dsh-ohos-shell"]
    }
  }
}
```

在设备上开发本包时，也可以把本包的绝对路径交给插件管理器。它会把该路径记为 `link:` 依赖。

While you develop this package on the device, give the plugin manager the absolute path of this package. It records that path as a `link:` dependency.

请勿手工编辑 profile 的 `package.json` 或 `cordis.patch.yml`。插件管理器负责这两步。

Do not edit the profile `package.json` or `cordis.patch.yml` by hand. The plugin manager owns these two steps.

## 5 功能 / What it does

### 5.1 环境变量 / Environment variables

`scrubbedParentEnv()` 在每次 spawn 时读取 `process.env`。`PATH`、`HOME`、区域设置与代理变量能通过这层清洗，凭据类名称与 `DSH_*` 名称不能。

`scrubbedParentEnv()` reads `process.env` at every spawn. `PATH`, `HOME`, locale, and proxy variables survive that scrub. Credential-shaped names and `DSH_*` names do not survive.

主进程在激活时改一次环境，就能同时覆盖侧栏终端、模型 shell、子智能体与 MCP 服务。

One change at activation in the host process reaches the sidebar terminal, the model shell, subagents, and MCP servers.

下表列出它设置的键。

The table below lists the keys that it sets.

| 键 | 值 |
|---|---|
| `PATH` | 去重，并按 `~/.zshrc` 的顺序把 harmonybrew 放在最前：`opt/rustup/bin`、pnpm `bin`、`opt/portable-git/bin`、`bin`、`sbin`。其余继承目录保留。 |
| `SHELL` | `zsh` 与 `bash` 中第一个存在的。 |
| `TMPDIR` | 先取继承的 `TMPDIR`，再取 `$HOME/.tmp`（不存在则创建），取第一个**真正可写**的目录。可写性用一次真实写入探测，因为 `/tmp` 在只读挂载上仍带 `1777` 权限。 |
| `NODE_OPTIONS` | 当 `$HOME/.config/node-ohos/userinfo-shim.cjs` 存在且尚未写入时，前置 `--require`。 |
| `FPATH` | 依次为：本包的 `zsh-functions/`、平台函数目录、继承的 `FPATH`。`FPATH` 与 zsh 的 `fpath` 特殊参数绑定，见 5.3 节。 |
| `HOMEBREW_PREFIX`、`HOMEBREW_CELLAR`、`HOMEBREW_REPOSITORY` | 探测到的前缀与继承值不同时写入。 |
| `INFOPATH` | 缺少 `<prefix>/share/info` 时前置。 |

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| `PATH` | De-duplicated, with harmonybrew first in the order that `~/.zshrc` establishes: `opt/rustup/bin`, pnpm `bin`, `opt/portable-git/bin`, `bin`, `sbin`. Other inherited directories stay. |
| `SHELL` | The first of `zsh` and `bash` that exists. |
| `TMPDIR` | The inherited `TMPDIR`, then `$HOME/.tmp` (created if absent). The first **actually writable** directory wins. A real write tests writability, because `/tmp` carries mode `1777` on a read-only mount. |
| `NODE_OPTIONS` | Prepends `--require` when `$HOME/.config/node-ohos/userinfo-shim.cjs` exists and is not present yet. |
| `FPATH` | In order: the `zsh-functions/` directory of this package, the platform functions directory, the inherited `FPATH`. `FPATH` is tied to the zsh `fpath` special parameter. See section 5.3. |
| `HOMEBREW_PREFIX`, `HOMEBREW_CELLAR`, `HOMEBREW_REPOSITORY` | Written when the detected prefix differs from the inherited value. |
| `INFOPATH` | Prepends `<prefix>/share/info` when it is absent. |

本包不改动模型 shell 的 `bash` 工具。`dsh-bash-local` 固定执行 `bash -c`，把 `SHELL` 改成 zsh 不影响它。

This package does not change the model shell `bash` tool. `dsh-bash-local` always runs `bash -c`, so a change of `SHELL` to zsh does not touch it.

### 5.2 侧栏默认 shell / Sidebar default shell

侧栏原来打开 mksh，因为主进程的 `SHELL` 是 `/bin/sh`。本包把 `SHELL` 指向第一个可用的 zsh 或 bash，侧栏的默认值随之改变。

The sidebar opened mksh before, because the host process `SHELL` was `/bin/sh`. This package points `SHELL` at the first available zsh or bash. The sidebar default changes with it.

选单中的候选 shell 来自 `shellCandidates` 配置，默认值为 `zsh`、`bash`、`fish`、`pwsh`、`powershell`、`cmd`。它们按 `PATH` 解析。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-keep-awake

DeepSeek Harness 主机保活插件：AI 任务运行时自动保持主机亮屏、防止休眠，全部任务结束后释放保活请求。

## 插件介绍

- 保活由 DSH 后端控制，支持多个会话和子 Agent；关闭网页或切换到后台不影响运行中的任务。
- 在侧边栏的**设置同一行**显示太阳图标，点击可查看状态、运行任务数量，以及开启或关闭保活。
- 使用普通用户权限的临时电源断言，不需要管理员权限，不修改全局电源设置，不模拟鼠标或键盘。
- Windows 使用 Power Request，macOS 使用 IOKit，Linux 使用 D-Bus ScreenSaver 和 logind。系统接口不可用时会显示部分生效或失败状态。
- 主机开关作用于当前 DSH 进程，重启后默认开启。插件停止或宿主退出时释放请求。

保护对象是**运行 DSH 后端的设备**。手动锁屏、合盖及系统强制策略可能覆盖保活。Linux 已实机验证；Windows 和 macOS 已实现，尚待实机验证。针对 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 开发。

## 安装方法

### 从 npm 安装（推荐）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @zi7tian/dsh-keep-awake
```

### 从 GitHub 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zi7tian/dsh-keep-awake
```

### 本地安装

```sh
git clone https://github.com/zi7tian/dsh-keep-awake.git
cd dsh-keep-awake
npm ci
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-keep-awake
```

将路径替换为实际插件目录，Windows 使用对应本地路径。插件依赖 Koffi，安装时会获取适合当前平台的原生组件；Linux 还需要系统提供 `libdbus-1` 及相应的会话服务。

安装或升级后，等待当前任务结束，**重启 `dsh web` 并刷新页面**。设置旁出现太阳图标即表示控制面板已加载。桌面版请通过其插件管理器安装。

### 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @zi7tian/dsh-keep-awake
```

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-gitee-chat

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-gitee-chat.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-gitee-chat)
[![CI](https://github.com/huayuguo/dsh-gitee-chat/actions/workflows/check.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/huayuguo/dsh-gitee-chat/actions/workflows/check.yml)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%5E0.2.0--rc.2-4a6cf7.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-gitee-chat.svg)](./LICENSE)

> DSH 插件：在会话里管 Gitee 企业项目。
> **模型只触发，脚本去拉数，卡片在对话里画图** —— 不做侧边栏，不维护本地数据库。

## 它解决什么

要么开侧边栏看板，要么把整坨 JSON 塞进模型上下文 —— 这个包把两件事拆开：

```
模型调用 gitee_board              ← 只触发一次
     │
     ├─→ gq 脚本拉 Gitee 企业版 API   ← 数据由后台脚本取，字段已裁剪
     ├─→ 模型只拿到 summary 摘要      ← 几十~一千 token，与数据量无关
     └─→ 卡片直接找宿主路由要全量数据  ← 不经过模型，想画多少画多少
```

一句话：**上下文占用与数据量解耦**。一千个工作项和十个工作项，模型看到的摘要一样长。

## 安装

三种来源都是同一份 `npm pack` 产物（`files` 白名单 + `prepare` 构建，拿来即用）：

| 来源 | 命令 | 什么时候用 |
|---|---|---|
| **npm 官方源**（推荐） | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-gitee-chat` | 默认；DSH 的标准安装方式 |
| GitHub Release 附件 | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add "https://github.com/huayuguo/dsh-gitee-chat/releases/download/v0.5.2/dsh-gitee-chat-0.5.2.tgz"` | 直连 GitHub 不稳时的备用 |
| git 直装 | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add "git+https://github.com/huayuguo/dsh-gitee-chat.git#v0.5.2"` | 想跟某个 tag / 分支 |

- **profile 要对**：桌面版是 `desktop`，`dsh web` 是 `web`。装错 profile 是**静默失效** —— 界面里什么都没有，也不报错。
- **桌面版的 `dsh` 用应用自带的那个**：全局装的 `dsh` 会拒绝 `--profile desktop`。路径在
  `<应用目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`；等价 GUI 入口是「设置 → 插件 → 添加插件」，
  填 `dsh-gitee-chat`（npm）或 `file:<本包目录>`（本地）。
- **升级 = `remove` + `add`**：`file:` 与 npm 装法都是副本，没有自动更新。
- npm 只往**官方源**（`registry.npmjs.org`）发一次；国内镜像会自动同步，**不要往镜像发**（也发不上去）。

### 让 AI 装上并配好（推荐）

本包自带一个 skill（`skills/dsh-gitee-chat/SKILL.md`），装了之后直接说：

> 帮我配置这个 Gitee 插件，配置项你问我。

它会探测环境（token 在不在、有几个企业、MCP 在不在、哪个 profile 装了本插件），
**只问三个它猜不到的**（用哪个企业、能不能直接改数据、规范要求几个标签），
把答案写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（**只替换本插件那一段**，改前先备份），最后自检并汇报。
配置类改动会热重载，**通常不用重启**。

### Windows 一键安装（新机器）

```bat
git clone https://github.com/huayuguo/dsh-gitee-chat.git
cd dsh-gitee-chat
scripts\install-dsh.cmd
```

脚本一次做完：Node（优先用桌面应用自带 runtime，没有才 `winget` 装 LTS）→ dsh CLI → pnpm →
本包构建 → `file:` 安装 → 写默认配置 → 自检，并把 PATH 在当前窗口刷好。某一步失败它会说清原因，
不假装成功。撤销：

```bat
scripts\uninstall-dsh.cmd              :: 全清：dsh + Node + 相关文件夹 + 脚本策略
scripts\uninstall-dsh.cmd --keep-node  :: 机器本来就有 Node，只清 dsh
```

安装/升级时的三处常见坑（PowerShell 执行策略、`ERR_PNPM_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE_VIOLATION`、
`link:` 装法的失败症状）见 [USAGE.md 附录](./USAGE.md#附录安装与升级的常见坑)。

### 手工 / 开发安装

```sh
pnpm install && node build.mjs
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:$PWD"

node scripts/setup.mjs apply     # 写配置（enterpriseId: 0 = 自动识别企业）
node scripts/setup.mjs verify    # 自检；新机器上「还没有 token」是预期，不算装失败
```

改 `src/`、跑自检、提 PR 的流程见 [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](./CONTRIBUTING.md)。

## 配置 token

在应用里 **设置 → Gitee 企业项目** 填 token 保存即可 —— 这是唯一的界面入口（会话里的
「Gitee 项目」标签页没有配置入口：没配 token 时那个标签页本来就打不开），存完即时生效。

取数脚本按优先级解析：

1. 环境变量 `GITEE_ENT_MCP_ACCESS_TOKEN`（或 `GITEE_ACCESS_TOKEN`、`GITEE_TOKEN`）
2. 文件 `$DSH_HOME/.gitee-chat/token`
3. 文件 `$DSH_HOME/gitee-chat-token`、`~/.gitee-token`

两个容易踩的点：

- **桌面版从开始菜单启动时不继承 shell 里 `export` 的变量**（只继承注册表里的用户/系统变量）——
  「网页版能用、桌面版说没有 token」多半是这个原因，所以**优先用界面填**。
- **已经挂载的 MCP 子进程**只在挂载时读一次 env 与 token 文件，改完要重启 DSH；
  `gq` 脚本每次调用现读（界面保存即时生效）。

自检：

```sh
node scripts/gitee/gq.mjs health   # token / 企业 / 连通性
node scripts/gitee/gq.mjs role     # 我是谁、什么人格、这个档能做什么
```

> Gitee 企业版端点要求 `Authorization: Bearer <token>` **加** MCP 同款 User-Agent，
> 两者缺一会返回 `Only For MCP Gitee Enterprise Application` —— 脚本已内置，自行 curl 时别漏。

## 界面

会话里有一张**看板卡片**（贴着那次工具调用），以及整屏的「**Gitee 项目**」标签页
（与 对话 / 轨迹 / 上下文 并列的第 4 个）。标签页自己拉数据（挂载即拉 + 右上角刷新），
**全程不经过模型**，所以数据多大都不占上下文：

| 页签 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 项目 | 企业 KPI 统计条 · 项目列表 · 工作项表（未完成 / 逾期 / 全部）· 点行下钻 |
| 仓库 | 仓库列表（两种口径）+ 仓库 WIKI |
| 固定分析 | 9 张卡片：项目健康度 / 成员负载 / 延期清单 / 停滞 / 规范体检 / 进度偏差 / 交付容量 / 里程碑达成 / 交付趋势 |
| 知识库 | 企业知识库文档树 · 预览分工 · 按需缓存与四态判定 |

点任意工作项进入**详情面板**：描述（Markdown 渲染）、**前置依赖**（区分已完成 / 未完成，
并明确说谁卡住了本项）、**评论中的讨论**，以及**直接操作**：改状态、改派、发评论。

固定分析全部由 `gq` 脚本计算（同一输入永远得到同一输出），阈值随数据下发；
需要判断力的部分（WBS 合理性、风险根因、复盘）才交给模型，且必须基于这些事实。

**前置依赖两种写法都认**：Gitee 编号（`IK90004`）与 WBS 编码（`- ME-02 结构布局确定`，
靠标题前缀 `【DEMO900-ME-02】` 反查、短码按 `-` 分段做后缀匹配）。只认编号的实现会把
「有 3 个前置项」显示成「写着没有前置依赖」，比不显示更糟。

## 工具与路由

| 面 | 名字 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 工具 | `gitee_board` | 拉看板数据；模型只得到摘要，卡片负责渲染 |
| 工具 | `gitee_role` | 解析当前 token 的身份、人格与能力档（管理者 / 负责人档 / 执行档） |
| 工具 | `gitee_enterprises` | 列出 / 切换当前企业 |
| 工具 | `gitee_chat_health` | 取数环境自检（token / 企业 / 连通性） |
| 工具 | `gitee_ent` | **公共 gateway**：任何 agent / 任何 preset 都能调 Gitee 企业 MCP，见下 |
| 路由 | `POST /api/gitee-chat/payload` | 卡片取全量数据（body: `{scope, program, refresh}`） |
| 路由 | `GET /api/gitee-chat/session?sessionId=` | 这个会话是不是 Gitee 模式（整屏视图与写路由的门禁依据） |
| 路由 | `GET /api/gitee-chat/issues?program=` | 单项目工作项清单 |
| 路由 | `GET /api/gitee-chat/issue?ident=` | 工作项详情：描述 + 前置依赖 + 评论 |
| 路由 | `GET /api/gitee-chat/states?type=` | 某工作项类型下的可选状态（改状态的选项来源） |
| 路由 | `GET /api/gitee-chat/members?program=` | 项目成员（改派的候选人） |
| 路由 | `POST /api/gitee-chat/write` | **唯一写入口**（改状态 / 评论 / 改派） |
| 路由 | `GET /api/gitee-chat/role` | 当前身份与人格（读缓存） |
| 路由 | `GET /api/gitee-chat/health` / `/ping` / `/preview` | 自检 / 存活 / 静态预览 |

所有路由都过与 `/api` 网关同款的 browser-trust fence（loopback 或部署的 trustedHosts + 同源）。
`/write` **额外要求** `sessionId` 属于一个 Gitee 模式的会话，否则 403 —— 这条路由挂在 profile 层，
凡是浏览器能打到 loopback 的都能打它，用会话身份把「谁能写」收敛住。

### 写回

所有改动都从 `src/host/write.ts` 出去，**全包唯一的写出口**，只允许三种操作：
`set-state` / `comment` / `assign`（正文走子进程 stdin，不塞 argv）。界面不做乐观更新：
写完重新拉一次详情，看到的就是服务端真值。`allowWrites: false` 的只读部署会明说
「写通道已关闭」，而不是给一堆点了会失败的按钮。

> 模型侧的写操作走它自己的 MCP 工具（`update_enterprise_issue` 等），那是**另一个平面**、
> 另一条通道，故意不复用：MCP 工具受能力档门禁约束，而 UI 只做最小写集合。

### `gitee_ent`：Gitee 企业 MCP 是公共工具

48 个 MCP 工具不限于 Gitee 模式，任意会话都能通过一个工具调到：

```text
gitee_ent(op:"list")                                  # 目录：工具名 + 首行说明，写工具带 ✎
gitee_ent(op:"schema", name:"list_enterprise_issues") # 这一个工具的参数说明
gitee_ent(op:"call",   name:"…", args:{…})            # 真正调用
```

两级暴露是为了省上下文：48 个工具的完整 schema 约 **14.6K tokens/请求**，而常驻的 gateway
说明只有约 **0.4K**，目录（只在实际用时进上下文）约 1.1K，单个工具的参数说明约 100–150 tokens。
Gitee 模式的会话不受影响：那里仍用原生 `mcp__gitee_ent__*`（gateway 在 Gitee 作用域里被隐藏），
能力档门禁一字未改。只读部署（`allowWrites: false`）下会硬拦 20 个写工具，
**Gitee 模式内外一个口径**。真正的权限边界始终在 Gitee 云端：能不能改，取决于 token 的身份
（拿不到就是 403/404），本地这层是「不给误操作的承诺」，不是安全边界。

## 换一台机器 / 换一个同事

这个包**不含**任何「本机 / 本公司」的硬编码，下面这些都能从配置或环境变量覆盖：

| 你会遇到的东西 | 它从哪来 | 怎么改 |
|---|---|---|
| 企业 id | `$DSH_HOME/.gitee-chat/config.json` | 界面「设置 → Gitee 企业项目 → 当前企业」里选（推荐，立即生效），或 `gq enterprises --use <id>`，或配置 `enterpriseId`，或环境变量 `GITEE_ENT_ID` |
| 企业版 token | 环境变量或 `$DSH_HOME/.gitee-chat/token` | 三种变量名任选其一；插件取数与 MCP 子进程**都按同一条顺序读它** |
| API base | 配置 `apiBase` | 私有化部署时改它 |
| User-Agent | 脚本内置默认值 | 配置 `userAgent` 或 `GITEE_ENT_USER_AGENT` |
| 分析阈值 | 脚本里的具名默认值 | 配置 `thresholds` 或 `GITEE_CHAT_*` 环境变量；**「标签数 = 3」是本团队的约定**，别人家设 2/4，或设 0 关闭 |
| 哪些 preset 算 Gitee 模式 | **按事实判定**：读 preset 组合，看有没有挂 `dsh-gitee-chat/agent` | 也可用配置 `presetIds: [...]` 显式列出；判定与 preset 名字无关 |
| MCP 可执行文件 | **随包分发**（`vendor/mcp-gitee-ent/`，linux + windows amd64），安装时自动落地到用户级 bin（Linux/macOS `~/.local/bin`，Windows `%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin`） | 什么都不用做。本平台未随包（arm64 / macOS）时才需 `go install`，或用 `MCP_GITEE_ENT_BIN` 指到已有二进制 |
| 知识库文档缓存 | 配置 `docs.root`，默认 `$DSH_HOME/gitee/docs` | 改 `docs.root`（支持 `~`）；**文档的端点不在这里配**，唯一实现是 MCP |
| MCP 文档工具名前缀 | 配置 `docs.mcpToolPrefix`，默认 `mcp__gitee_ent__` | 只有改了 preset 里 `mcp-gitee` 行的 `serverName` 才需要动它 |

已知的**不**可移植之处（刻意保留）：两个 preset 的 `agent.cordis.yml` 是从官方 `standard` preset
复制的组合快照，DSH 升级后需要重新同步（`pnpm run doctor` 会检查引用的插件行能否解析）；
`--enabled-toolsets` 由 `TIERS` 生成（`pnpm run capabilities:check` 挡漂移）；界面文案只有中文。

## 兼容性

`engines.dsh` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 的 peer 范围都写在当前 release 线上（当前 `^0.2.0-rc.2`）——
**跟随最新 DSH，不背旧版**，老 harness 会被拒绝安装。升级 DSH 之后跑一次 `pnpm run check`：
它会把 peer / `engines.dsh` 该改成的值打出来；装完可以用一句确认：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop list   # 还打印 `is incompatible with dsh …` 就是范围没跟上
```

范围没跟上的表现是启动日志里 `skipping profile bundle "dsh-gitee-chat"` —— 插件整个不加载，
标签页和工具一起消失。

## 验证

```sh
pnpm run check                  # 一站式：smoke + render-chec

plugins.description: dsh-update-vd
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-update-vd

> DSH Desktop 更新中心：**侧栏版本号** + **一条「更新」按钮** + **带进度条的更新弹窗**，
> 下载完自动替换 `/Applications` 里的 app 并重启 —— 不用再把 DMG 里的 app 手动拖进 Applications。

一个基于 **DeepSeek Harness / DSH Desktop** 的 Cordis 插件（宿主端 + 客户端），把 DSH Desktop 的
更新体验换成一条自动链路；另外给设置面板加了 **技能**、**MCP**、**智能体（Agent 预设）**、**导入**
四页（「导入」＝ 从本机其它 AI 工具把智能体预设 / 对话记录搬进来，v1.9.1 从智能体页搬出来独立成页），
技能 / MCP / 智能体都支持按「源地址」联网搜索与一键取用。侧栏还带一个**笔记**弹窗；
**设置 → 账号与余额** 的「充值余额」下面还有一张 **Token 活动**热力图（一天一格，每天 / 每周 / 年 / 累计总量四种模式）。

---

## ✨ 功能

### 1. 侧栏底部那一行（账号行上面）
- 平时：`版本 2.0.16` + `[检查更新]`
- 有新版本：`2.0.16 → 2.0.17` + 高亮的 `[更新]`
- 下载中：`正在下载 28%` + 一条细进度条
- 取消过 / 断网过：`[继续下载]`（**断点续传**）
- 侧栏收起成窄栏时是一个图标按钮，有新版本时带一个小圆点

### 2. 更新弹窗
| 场景 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 正在下载 | 「升级 APP / 正在为您更新，请耐心等待 / 已下载 28%」+ 进度条 + `[取消] [后台升级]` |
| 点 **取消** | **二次确认**：「确定要取消下载吗？」`[继续下载] [确定取消]`，并说明已下载的部分会保留 |
| 点 **空白处** / Esc | 隐藏弹窗 = **后台升级**（下载继续，侧栏那行继续显示百分比）。二次确认开着时，点空白处只收回确认 |
| 取消过 / 失败过 | 提示「上次已下载 32%，从断点继续」，点继续就是**接着下**（HTTP Range），不从头来 |
| 下载完成 | 自动挂载 DMG → 校验版本与签名 → 替换 app → 自动重启 |

### 3. 装机细节
- 全程只请求 `dshdesktop.cn` 两个固定端点，重定向到别的主机直接拒绝。
- 安装前先整份 `ditto` 到暂存目录并 `codesign --verify --deep --strict` 验签，
  通过之后才「移开旧的 / 换上新的」（任一步失败都把旧的搬回来）。
- 退出旧 app 用三保险：`killall -TERM <CFBundleExecutable>` → `osascript … quit` →
  等它的 HTTP 端口关掉，超时再 `killall -KILL`。

### 4. 设置 → **技能**（`settings.section` = skills）
- 列出所有技能（含随包发布的、项目里的，只读的会标出来），带来源与磁盘路径；
- **搜索**（名字 / 描述）；**新增**、**编辑**（改名字 / 描述 / Markdown 正文）；
- **删除**要二次确认（并显示会被删掉的路径）；
- **导入**：给一个 http/https 地址（抓 SKILL.md），或给一个本机路径（技能目录 / 单个 .md）；
  重名会明确报错，不覆盖。
- 可写目录：`~/.dsh/skills`、`~/.agents/skills`（随包 / 项目里的只展示，不改写）。

### 5. 设置 → **MCP**（`settings.section` = mcp）
- 列出 MCP 服务器（名字 / 类型 / 地址或命令 / 是否连上）；
- **搜索**、**新增**、**编辑**、**删除**（要确认）、**启用 / 停用**；
- 两种类型都支持：`streamable-http`（URL + 请求头）与 `stdio`（命令 + 参数 + 环境变量）；
- 清单存在 `~/.dsh/mcp-servers.json`，保存后**立刻挂载/断开**（内部按 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`
  的行来动态挂载），不用改 profile 的 patch，也不用重启。连不上会明确告诉你哪个服务器、什么原因。

### 6. 设置 → **智能体**（`settings.section` = agents，排在「MCP」后面）

> 「**从其它 AI 导入**」v1.9.1 起**不在这一页里了** —— 它搬成了导航里「智能体」**下面**独立的一页
> 「**导入**」（`settings.section` = `other-ai`，order 160），见下面第 9 节。

管的是 DSH 的 **Agent 预设**：一个预设就是一行 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` 声明，
`config.plugins`（正文）决定这个智能体能用哪些插件/工具。

- **列表**：内置的（`standard` / `ptc` / `minimal` / `cordis`，随 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` 发布）、
  你/别人随包装的、以及本插件自己加的都在一起。每条显示名字、来源徽标、简介（截断两行）、
  标识、插件数 / 工具行数；装配失败的会标红并把 DSH 给的诊断原样贴出来；
- **搜索**：按名字 / 标识 / 简介 / 来源实时过滤；
- **新建 / 编辑 / 删除**：标识 + 名字 + 简介 + 排序 + 模型备注 + 正文（DSH patch 的条目清单 YAML）。
  正文也可以勾「这段是系统提示词」直接写一段话（保存时自动包成一行 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona`）。
  删除要**二次确认**；
- **内置的只读，但可以「复制一份」**：选它的理由 —— 内置预设随包发布、重启/升级会被覆盖，
  允许改会造成「我改的东西下次更新就没了」的错觉；而拦住用户又不合适，所以给一条明确的出路：
  任意预设（含内置）都能「复制一份」成自己的副本再改；
- **导入**：粘贴内容 / 选本地文件 / 给本机路径 / 给 http(s) 地址，四种随便挑一种。
  重名会明确报错，并给出「自动改个名字」和「覆盖同名自定义预设」两个显式选项 —— **不会静默覆盖**；
- **导出**：单条导出 + 全部导出，下载成文件（Blob + `createObjectURL` + `<a download>`）。
  两种格式：本插件 JSON（再导入时名字/简介/模型备注一起还原）、DSH 补丁 YAML（贴进 bundle 就能用）；
- **在线搜索 + 装第三方**：见下面第 7 节；
- **从其它 AI 导入**：见下面第 9 节 —— v1.9.1 起它是设置里**独立的一页**（导航「导入」，排在「智能体」下面），
  这一页不再有那个入口按钮。

数据落在 `~/.dsh/agent-presets.json`。保存后在运行时动态挂载那一行声明
（跟 MCP 一个套路：`ctx.plugin(模块, config)`），所以**不用改 profile 的 patch、也不用重启**；
删掉就是 dispose，`agentPresets` 注册表里同步消失。第三方预设如果引用的插件包没装，
它会留在列表里并标成「装配失败」，把 DSH 的报错原样显示出来 —— 装好那个包再重启 DSH 即可。

### 7. 在线搜索（三个页面都有，**多个源可选**）

技能页进「导入」就能看到；MCP 页与智能体页点「在线搜索」。选一个**源地址** → 填关键字 → 搜索 → 一键取用。

| 页面 | 内置源 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 技能 | `anthropics/skills` | Anthropic 官方技能库（20+ SKILL.md） |
| 技能 | `obra/superpowers` | 社区技能合集 |
| 技能 | 自定义地址… | 填 `owner/repo` 或完整 GitHub 链接（任何放 SKILL.md 的仓库都能搜） |
| MCP | MCP 官方注册表 | `registry.modelcontextprotocol.io`，按关键字搜，结果自带 `streamable-http` URL 或 stdio 启动命令 |
| MCP | `modelcontextprotocol/servers` | 官方参考实现（自动填成 `npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-<名字>`） |
| MCP | 自定义地址… | 别的注册表 URL，或 `owner/repo` |
| 智能体 | **本机自带预设** | 直接读随包的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/presets/*.patch.yml`（离线可用；取用＝复制一份成自定义） |
| 智能体 | `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` | 上游官方预设集合（standard / ptc / minimal / cordis） |
| 智能体 | `AcidGr/dsh-preset-mobile-use` | 第三方预设（手机自动化 Agent），**装它＝把别人的插件行挂进你的 DSH** |
| 智能体 | 自定义地址… | `owner/repo`，或一个 `.patch.yml` 的完整 https 地址 |

- 技能：搜到直接「导入这个」→ 抓 raw 的 SKILL.md 存成 `~/.dsh/skills/<名字>/SKILL.md`；
- MCP：搜到点「用它新建」→ 表单自动填好，确认后再保存（保存即挂载）；
- 智能体：搜到点「装到本机」→ 抓那份 patch、把里面的预设声明写进本机清单并**立刻挂载**（默认自动改名，不覆盖你已有的）。
  智能体的源是「扫仓库里所有 patch 文件，找带 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` 声明的」，所以任何按
  DSH 约定发布预设的仓库都能当源；
- **智能体的搜索结果有 10 分钟缓存**：一次搜索要花十几次 GitHub 请求，而未登录配额只有 60 次/小时，
  所以同一个仓库 10 分钟内换关键字重搜是 0 次请求（结果里会写「N 秒前抓的缓存」）；
- 都是公开只读接口、不需要 key。GitHub 未登录配额 60 次/小时，所以仓库清单有 10 分钟缓存；
- 搜索失败会把真实原因（HTTP 状态 / 认不出的地址）原样显示出来，不吞。

### 8. 从本机其它 AI 工具导入（技能 / MCP 两页有）

| 页面 | 从哪读 | 读到什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 技能 | `~/.codex/skills/*/SKILL.md`、`~/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md`、`~/.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md` | 勾选后复制进 `~/.dsh/skills/<名字>/`（同名会标出来，不覆盖） |
| MCP | Codex `~/.codex/config.toml`（含 `[mcp_servers.X.env]`）、Claude `~/.claude.json`、Cursor `~/.cursor/mcp.json`、Windsurf、Gemini CLI、OpenCode、Continue | 勾选后写进清单并**立刻挂载**；没连上会在界面上说清楚是哪个、为什么 |

实测这台机器：从 Codex 扫到 **12 个技能 + 4 个 MCP 服务器**，从 Claude 扫到 1 个，导入后文件真的落到 `~/.dsh/skills/`、清单真的落盘、挂载真的被调用（生成的配置还拿 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 的官方 Zod schema 校验过）。

### 9. 从其它 AI 导入（设置里**独立的一页**：导航「导入」，在「智能体」下面）

导航里点「**导入**」→ 就是这一页（`settings.section` 的 `other-ai`，order 160，排在「智能体」150 下面；
v1.9.1 从「智能体」页**搬出来**，那边的入口按钮已经删掉），里面有**两个页签**：

| 页签 | 导什么 |
| --- | --- |
| **智能体预设**（默认） | 那几家里的「智能体 / 提示词 / 技能」，导成 DSH 智能体预设（见下面 9.1） |
| **对话记录** | 那几家里的**历史会话**，导成**真正的 DSH 会话**（能在左侧会话列表打开、能接着聊；见下面 9.2） |

#### 9.1 智能体预设页签

默认四个来源，**装了就把里面的智能体/提示词一键导成 DSH 智能体预设**，没装就**照旧显示出来**并给官网入口
（`window.open` 新窗口）—— 不把没装的藏起来。

| 来源 | 探测判据 | 能导入什么 | 官网 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Codex** | `~/.codex` 存在 | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md`（它的全局指令文件）、`~/.codex/prompts/*.md` | [developers.openai.com/codex](https://developers.openai.com/codex/) |
| **Claude Code** | `~/.claude/agents` 或 `~/.claude` 存在 | `~/.claude/agents/*.md`（子代理：`name`/`description` 来自 frontmatter，正文＝系统提示词）、`~/.claude/commands/*.md` | [claude.com/product/claude-code](https://claude.com/product/claude-code) |
| **TRAE** | `/Applications/Trae.app`（国内版 `Trae CN.app`）或 `trae` CLI **并且** 配置目录在 | `~/.trae/skills/*/SKILL.md`、`~/.trae/memory/user_profile.md`、`~/.trae-cn/skills/*/SKILL.md` | [trae.cn](https://www.trae.cn/) |
| **WorkBuddy** | `~/.workbuddy` 存在 | `SOUL.md`（人格总纲）/ `IDENTITY.md`（身份卡）/ `USER.md`（用户画像）、`~/.workbuddy/skills/*/SKILL.md` | [workbuddy.ai](https://www.workbuddy.ai/) |

- **Codex 没有「子代理」这个概念**，所以能导的是「全局指令 + 提示词」，界面上写明了它们是它的全局指令文件；
- **TRAE 是特例**：光有 `~/.trae` / `~/.trae-cn` 只是别的工具留下的配置残渣，必须 app 或 CLI 在才算「装了」，
  否则界面上标「只有配置残渣」并显示下载入口。它自带的重型技能包（`builtin_skills` 等）故意不列 ——
  几十上百 KB 且依赖它的运行时，导过来没有意义；
- **导入的形态**：因为这几家都不是 DSH 预设格式，统一转成「一段系统提示词」的 DSH 智能体预设
  （正文就是一行 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona`），落到 `~/.dsh/agent-presets.json` 并**立刻挂载**。
  撞内置/撞已有都会**明确报错**，可以勾「重名自动改名」导成副本；只有「同一来源的同一项再导一次」
  才当作幂等刷新（不然连点两次就报错太蠢）；
- **可以加第三方来源**：填一个**本机路径**（md 文件，或一个目录 —— 里面的 `*.md` 会一个一个列出来）
  或一个 **http/https 地址**（一个文件，或一个 GitHub 仓库 —— 会去找里面的 `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` /
  `agents/` / `prompts/`）。加进清单后能删；删来源**不会**删已经导进来的预设；
- **探测是只读且很快的**：只看它自己的配置目录/可执行文件在不在（`existsSync` + 单层 `readdir`），
  不递归扫 home、不上网、进程启动时也不扫（打开这一页才跑一次），界面上把「探测的是什么」原样写出来。

#### 9.2 对话记录页签（把「聊过的会话」搬进 DSH）

这一页的第二个页签不导智能体，导的是**对话本身**：Codex / Claude Code / WorkBuddy 聊过的那些会话，
可以**一键导成真正的 DSH 会话** —— 导完在左侧会话列表里就能打开、能接着聊。

| 来源 | 对话文件长什么样 | 本机实测 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Codex** | `~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-*.jsonl` + `~/.codex/archived_sessions`；首行 `session_meta`，正文是 `response_item` | 230 + 11 个文件 → **117 条会话**（一个 session 会分卷成多个文件，按 `session_id` 合并） |
| **Claude Code** | `~/.claude/projects/<目录转义名>/<uuid>.jsonl`（`type: user/assistant`） | **22 条** |
| **WorkBuddy** | `~/.workbuddy/projects/<目录转义名>/<uuid>.jsonl`（标题从 `~/.workbuddy/workbuddy.db` 只读补） | **213 条** |
| **TRAE** | `~/.trae/assistant`、`~/.trae-cn/assistant` **都是空目录** | **暂不支持解析这个工具的对话格式**（对话在它自己的云端 / 应用内数据库里，没有稳定的本地文件可读）——界面上如实写明 |

- **列表**：标题（优先来源自己的标题 → 首条**真实**用户消息 → session id）、时间、消息条数、来源徽标。
  上游塞进「用户消息」里的注入上下文（Codex 的 `# AGENTS.md instructions…` / `<recommended_plugins>`、

plugins.description: Agent-authored monitoring and control panels for real machines and apps in DeepSeek Harness. A2UI-inspired, persistent, extensible.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Control Studio

**Your agent manages. Control Studio remembers.**

A DeepSeek Harness plugin for delegating machine and application management to your agent. Describe the target and the job; the agent can register the machine, investigate its applications, save what matters, and build an interface you can use again.

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Download v0.3.1](https://github.com/zhaochengggg/dsh-control-studio/releases/tag/v0.3.1) · [Setup](docs/setup.md) · [End-to-end walkthrough](docs/story.md)

## 1. Tell the agent what to manage

> “Register this machine as Queue server. Find the queue application and remember where it lives.”

The agent checks existing records and uses `machine_manage` to create or update the machine archive. Supply connection details through your approved access setup when needed; manual registration is an optional fallback, not a prerequisite.

![Agent registration result and the saved machine archive](docs/media/agent-register.gif)

*8 seconds · Review the completed agent registration and open its saved record.*

## 2. Turn application knowledge into a working panel

> “Show running, waiting, completed and failed jobs, with concurrency. Start read-only.”

The agent reads the application, records its location and purpose, and proposes a tailored card. You review the execution definitions before publication; the plugin keeps the notes, card versions and operation receipts.

![Saved application knowledge and the published card](docs/media/agent-card.gif)

*8 seconds · Inspect the saved application notes and refresh the published panel.*

## 3. Use it directly—or delegate the next job

Open the machine to use its saved panel. Click **@** when you want the agent to investigate or change something; it can retrieve the existing context instead of starting from scratch.

![Reference the machine in a conversation with @](docs/media/agent-mention.gif)

*7.5 seconds · Attach the machine to chat; no new request is submitted.*

*Three short recordings of real DSH, using fictional local demo data. Completed results are revisited, not presented as live generation. [Details and still images](docs/story.md).* The plugin keeps knowledge the agent explicitly saves; it does not automatically remember every conversation.

Another application: [dual-GPU monitoring and power controls](docs/gpu-walkthrough.md). The same workflow can leave you a very different interface.

## What is included

| Capability | What it gives you |
| --- | --- |
| Machine directory | Persistent records, multiple SSH paths, default connection, health checks, and @ references |
| Application cards | Model-authored layouts, data bindings, conditional controls, and numeric color scales |
| Persistent operations | Card revisions, publication review, execution permissions, and action receipts |
| Extensible UI | A component catalog plus custom card extensions when standard components are insufficient |
| Agent skills | Machine management, card authoring, and extension development guidance shipped with the plugin |

The UI follows an **A2UI-inspired** approach: the agent describes a structured interface and the host renders it. This is not a claim of full A2UI protocol compatibility. Custom extensions are a separate, code-bearing capability and should be reviewed accordingly.

## Install

**Prerelease. Verified: Linux · DSH `0.2.1-alpha.1` · Node `24.19`.** Other DSH versions may require adaptation. Independent community project, not an official DeepSeek plugin.

Download and verify the prebuilt package:

```sh
curl -fL -o dsh-control-studio-0.3.1.tgz \
  https://github.com/zhaochengggg/dsh-control-studio/releases/download/v0.3.1/dsh-control-studio-0.3.1.tgz
curl -fL -o SHA256SUMS \
  https://github.com/zhaochengggg/dsh-control-studio/releases/download/v0.3.1/SHA256SUMS
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
```

After the checksum reports `OK`, install as the DSH user:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-control-studio-0.3.1.tgz --allow-build=esbuild
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Restart DSH and refresh the browser. Replace `web` with your profile name if needed. This is **one package**; no legacy plugins are required. Use the release tarball, not a git install. `--allow-build=esbuild` approves the extension builder's dependency script; see [setup and permissions](docs/setup.md) before enabling execution.

## Start with a read-only card

Already using `dsh-machine-apps`? Follow the [rename migration guide](docs/migration.md) before installing. Do not enable both packages together.

Ask the agent to use `machine-management` to register the target and record its connection, then `app-cards-authoring` to inspect the application and propose a read-only panel. For a machine already in the directory, reference it with @. Add controls after confirming what each action executes.

Opening a card does not automatically apply its settings. Local execution is not authorized by default. This plugin does not change network exposure, proxies, authentication, or GPU services during installation.

## Go deeper

- [Setup, permissions, data locations, upgrades, and development](docs/setup.md)
- [GPU example: request, preview, and everyday use](docs/gpu-walkthrough.md)
- [Card authoring skill](apps/skills/app-cards-authoring/SKILL.md)
- [Custom extension skill](apps/skills/app-cards-extensions/SKILL.md)
- [Machine management skill](skills/machine-management/SKILL.md)

Have an application you want to manage? [Open an issue](https://github.com/zhaochengggg/dsh-control-studio/issues) with your DSH version, intended panel, and redacted logs or screenshots. Do not include credentials or private machine addresses.

plugins.description: STRATA · 地层 — DSH UI 皮肤：工业网格 + 等高线背景，浅色纸面 / 深色终端两套底
plugins.readme_text:
# STRATA · DSH UI 皮肤

[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0969da?logo=github)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4d6bfe)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![test](https://github.com/tenebris173/dsh-skin-strata/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tenebris173/dsh-skin-strata/actions/workflows/test.yml)

> 罗德岛终端风格 · 直角切角 · 黑色发丝线 · 黄黑警示条 · DIN 技术字

按 **`dsh.ecosystem.ui-skin-loader/v1`** 公约实现的 DSH 皮肤包。装好后出现在
**设置 → 皮肤** 的卡片墙里，与其它皮肤并列，一键切换。

![外观矩阵](preview/strata-matrix.png)

## 运行模式：有控制台托管，没控制台自立

| 场景 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| **装了皮肤控制台** | 登记托管：出现在 **设置 → 皮肤管理** 卡片墙里，由控制台负责互斥切换 / 持久化 / 故障隔离 |
| **没装控制台** | 等待 3 秒宽限后进入**自立模式**：自动应用外观，并在「设置 → STRATA」里给出开关与全部调节项 |

> **不会误判**：皮肤用运行时提供的 `ctx.inject(["uiSkinLoader"], cb)` **显式等待**控制台服务出现，
> 而不是在加载瞬间"看一眼有没有"。所以即使控制台比皮肤晚一步就绪，也仍然会正常登记（这是上一版踩过的坑）。

### 对控制台 / 脚本的接口

无论哪种模式，皮肤都暴露一个统一入口：

```js
window.__dshSkins["skins.strata"]
// { mode: "console" | "standalone", skinId, version,
//   isActive(), activate(), deactivate(), getSettings(), setSettings(patch) }
```

### 「原生」选项

设置面板里的 **「皮肤」下拉** 第一项是 **原生（默认观感）** —— 选中即还原默认皮肤：

- 有控制台时：调用控制台的 `switchTo("default")`（与控制台自己的"还原默认观感"同一路径），持久化归控制台；
- 自立模式时：直接关掉自己（`enabled=false`），立即卸下并**长期保持原生**，随时可再从下拉里选回本皮肤。

控制台是**可选**的第三方插件，不随本包分发。

## 这是一个 DSH 插件

本仓库是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的插件（皮肤类）。
按官方 README「Community and support」一节的要求，仓库已打上
[`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic，便于在
[github.com/topics/dsh-plugin](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) 被发现；
`package.json` 的 `keywords` 与 `dsh.skin.tags` 里同样带 `dsh-plugin`。

三种安装方式，任选其一：

| 方式 | 命令 / 操作 |
| --- | --- |
| git（无需下载包） | `dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/tenebris173/dsh-skin-strata` |
| 美化包 | 从 Releases 下 `STRATA-UI-*.zip`，双击 `安装STRATA皮肤.cmd` |
| 本地源码 | 见下方「安装 → B. 从源码装」 |

> 装完**必须重启 DSH**（插件包只在启动时进启动图），随后在 **设置 → 皮肤** 里一键切换。

## 外观

| 项 | 选项 | 默认 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 外观 | 跟随应用 / 纸面（亮）/ 终端（暗） | 跟随应用 |
| 强调色 | 警示黄 / 工程橙 / 信号青 | 警示黄 |
| 圆角 | 直角 0px / 工作台 6px / 圆润 12px | 直角 |
| 纹理 | 全屏细网格 + 扫描线 + 四角登记标记 | 开 |
| 硬投影 | 浮窗错位实心影 + 按钮按压位移 | 开 |
| DIN 技术字 | 拉丁文用 Bahnschrift（中文回落雅黑） | 开 |

3 × 3 × 3 × 2 × 2 × 2 = **216 种组合**，改档即时生效并跨重启保留
（皮肤自治：`localStorage`，键 `dsh.skin.strata.preferences.v1`）。

**跟随应用**：读 `ctx.theme.getTheme().preference`，为 `system` 时用 `prefers-color-scheme`
判定；1s 轮询 + `matchMedia` 监听，应用换主题时自动重算。

## 两套底

| | 纸面（Paper · 亮） | 终端（Terminal · 暗） |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 底 / 面板 / 卡片 | `#f4f5f7` / `#ffffff` / `#ffffff` | `#0d1012` / `#121618` / `#171c1f` |
| 发丝线 | 黑 18–60% | 冷白 15–60% |
| 实心块（徽标 / 主按钮 / DONE 章） | 黑底白字 | **反相**：冷白底深字 |
| 代码 token | `#1d3f63` `#7a4b12` `#b5342a` | `#8ab7ea` `#e0a45c` `#ff9a8a` |
| 警示黄 | `#ffd100` | `#ffd100` |

## 安装

### A. 用打包好的美化包（推荐给最终用户）

下载 release 里的 `STRATA-UI-*.zip`，解压后双击 `安装STRATA皮肤.cmd`。脚本会找到本机 DSH
（优先用你**正在运行**的那个），用官方途径装进 `desktop` profile，并把 `activeSkin` 切到本皮肤。

### B. 从源码装（开发）

```powershell
# 应用目录（默认装在当前用户的 LocalAppData 下；装在 Program Files 时改成对应路径）
$app = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness"
$cli = "$app\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop-host\lib\cli.js"

# 以软链方式安装（改代码刷新即生效）
& "$app\DeepSeek Harness.exe" $cli plugin --profile desktop add "<本仓库绝对路径>"

# 卸载
& "$app\DeepSeek Harness.exe" $cli plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-skin-strata
```

装完**必须重启 DSH**（新增插件包只在启动时进启动图）。切换皮肤也可以直接在
**设置 → 皮肤** 里点，不必手改配置。

## 设计语言

1. **纸面/终端，不是"深色科幻"** —— 层级只靠 1px 线与明度差，零阴影、零光晕、零圆角。
2. **切角而非圆角** —— `border-radius: 0`；面板头是黑底白字条 + 黄色 ▶；浮窗用错位实心影。
3. **警示黄只给四处** —— 当前 / 可点 / 运行中 / 焦点；其余全部黑白灰。
4. **DIN 技术字 + 字距** —— 拉丁文 Bahnschrift 大写标签；中文雅黑托底；数字等宽。

## 实现要点

- **观感承载**：`theme.overrideTokens()` 覆盖宿主公开 token —— `--dsw-alias-*`(107)、
  `--dsw-specific-*`(11)、`--dsw-menu-*`、`--dsw-linear-*`、`--dsw-radius-*`（直角 0）、
  `--dsw-static-neutral(-bluish)-*` 中性灰阶、`--dsw-font-family` / `--ds-font-family-code`。
- **驱动宿主亮暗开关**：`body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 由皮肤按有效底置位 / 摘除 —— 否则
  `--dsw-specific-*` 这类"只在 scheme 分支里有定义"的表面会落在错误的一档（实测过：
  纸面模式下输入框仍是深色）。
- **浮层实色兜底**：`[role="dialog"] / [aria-modal] / [role="menu|listbox|tooltip"]`
  强制实色 + 直角（STRATA 的表面本就是实心的，弹窗天然不透出正文）。
- **装饰层**：注入 7 个自有节点（网格、扫描线、左缘警示条、四角登记标记），
  `pointer-events:none` + `z-index:1`（低于菜单 100 / 弹窗 1000），退出时整体移除。
- **生命周期**（公约 §4.3 / R8）：activate 的每项副作用都登记 disposer，teardown 幂等；
  `deactivate` / `skinCtx.signal` abort / fiber 意外 dispose 三路汇合，退出后 token 与节点全部还原。
- **主题注册兜底**：重复 id 时改用带序号的 id，皮肤重载后不会整次回滚成默认。
- **设置面板**：经 `settings.section` 席位注册 React 组件，只在皮肤激活时出现。

## 自测

| 脚本 | 覆盖 | 断言 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tests/browser-smoke.mjs` | 控制台路径：登记载荷 / 激活副作用 / **真实 CSS 层叠** / teardown | 32 |
| `tests/console-wait.mjs` | 控制台迟到 1 秒（不许误判自立）/ 始终不出现（自立 + 能回原生） | 18 |
| `tests/skin-selector.mjs` | 「皮肤」选择器：控制台模式走 switchTo / 自立模式走开关自己 | 9 |
| `tests/contrast.mjs` | **每个强调色 × 每种底**：文字/标签对比度 ≥4.5:1，亮底派生深档 | 25 |
| `tests/dependency-check.mjs` | 宿主半依赖自检 | 6 |

合计 **90 项断言**。

## 目录

```
lib/index.js          宿主半（空 apply：观感全在 client 半）
lib/client.js         皮肤本体（登记 / token 表 / 两套底 / 外观面板 / 生命周期）
cordis.patch.yml      bundle patch（row id = 设置命名空间）
install/              一键安装 / 卸载脚本（美化包同款）
preview/              外观矩阵图 + 卡片预览 SVG
tests/browser-smoke.mjs
```

## 更新记录

见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 许可

MIT。

plugins.description: Aqua glassmorphism theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH v0.2.x / desktop v0.22.3+) — original by WYH66666666, adapted for 0.2.x
plugins.readme_text:
># @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-aqua

**Aqua** 是一层高自由度的玻璃质感主题（glassmorphism），套在 DeepSeek Harness 网页端：顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行、轨迹视图全部变成磨砂玻璃片，支持流体背景或图片/视频壁纸。关掉总开关即完全还原原生界面，不改 DSH 任何一行源码。

> **署名 / Credits**
> - 原作者：**WYH66666666** — https://github.com/WYH66666666/DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin
> - 0.1.1-rc.2 适配：**du-u-uck** — https://github.com/du-u-uck/DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin
> - v0.2.x 适配（本仓库）：**acdsh4869**

> **修改声明 / Modification Notice**
>
> 本仓库是原作品的**修改 / 适配版**，不是原创。
> - 原作者（Original author）：**WYH66666666**
> - 修改内容（Changes）：DeepSeek Harness **0.2.x** 兼容适配
> - 修改日期（Date of modification）：**2026-10**
> - 维护仓库（Maintained at）：`acdsh4869/dsh-aqua-theme`
> - 许可（License）：**AGPL-3.0**（沿用上游许可）

![](assets/1.png)

![](assets/2.png)

![](assets/3.png)

![](assets/4.png)

## 特性

- **双模式**：**云母效果**把布局改成悬浮玻璃卡片（模糊度、磨砂度可调）；**兼容模式**保持原版排版不变，只把材质换成通用玻璃，其他插件的界面也会自动玻璃化
- **背景自由**：流体板（色调/深浅可调）或自定义图片/视频壁纸（铺满页面、比例不变，可单独调模糊度/磨砂度）；浅色壁纸配浅色模式、深色壁纸配深色模式观感更佳
- **背景亮度**：自动跟随深浅模式——深色模式 0–50 压暗、浅色模式 50–100 提亮，50 原样
- **粒子鲸鱼 / 小鱼 / 网状交互 / 鼠标辉光 / 悬停下压**等环境与悬停装饰，均可单独开关
- **一键恢复默认**：设置里的「恢复默认效果」按钮可把全部调节项恢复出厂默认
- 一键开关：关闭即完全还原原生界面，无残留

## 安装（v0.2.x 适配版）

> ⚠️ **npm 一键安装（`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-client-ui-aqua`）拉到的是未适配 v0.2.x 的旧版**，请勿使用，直到本适配版发布到 npm。

### 方式一：PowerShell 一键安装（推荐）

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/acdsh4869/dsh-aqua-theme/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

脚本会：① 从本仓库下载最新 Release；② 把插件链接进 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-client-ui-aqua`；③ 在 `profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml` 登记 `ui-aqua`（幂等，重复运行安全）。完成后**刷新 Web 界面**即可。

指定版本或分支：`-Version 'v2.0.0-rc.1'` / `-Version 'main'`；DSH 不在默认位置时加 `-DshHome`。

### 方式二：本地文件夹安装

下载或 clone 本仓库到本地，然后：

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command ".\install.ps1 -Source '绝对路径\dsh-aqua-theme' -Profile web"
```

本地路径会建立 **junction 软链**（实时生效，之后在本文件夹里改代码/重建会直接反映到 DSH，无需重装）。

**macOS / Linux（手动三步）：**

```sh
git clone https://github.com/acdsh4869/dsh-aqua-theme.git
ln -s "$PWD/dsh-aqua-theme" "$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-aqua"
```

再往 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 追加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ui-aqua
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-aqua'
```

> 💡 也可以把整个仓库文件夹丢给其他 Agent 帮忙安装，有问题让它自己修复。

## 使用

刷新 Web 界面，Aqua **默认开启**：

- **总开关**：设置 → 插件 → 点击 **Aqua / dsh-client-ui-aqua** bundle 卡片进入详情页 → 玻璃主题开关卡片。
- **全部调节**：设置 → 通用设置 → 外观 正下方（无独立标题）—— 模式（云母/兼容）、模糊度/磨砂度、流体颜色、背景亮度、背景（流体/壁纸）、壁纸设置、环境装饰（鲸鱼/小鱼/网状交互）与悬停效果开关，以及「恢复默认效果」一键按钮。总开关关闭时整块调节自动隐藏，界面完全恢复原生样式。

> 若刷新后未出现 Aqua 卡片，重启 dsh web 进程后再试。

## 适配 v0.2.x 说明（当前版本）

本分发版针对 **DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`（含桌面端 v0.22.3 及以上）** 完成适配，版本号 `2.0.0-rc.1`。主要变更：

1. **`ctx.settingsScope` 服务被移除**：插件主卡片迁移到 **`plugins.bundle.config`**（keyed，key = npm 包名）。
2. **`ctx.slots.inject(name, factory)` 回归**：注册恢复为 `ctx.effect(() => ctx.slots.inject(...))`。
3. **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` 消失**：`defineStore` 改用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`；`ctx.slots` 类型合并来自 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer/client`。
4. **图标改名**：`IconCheckOutline16` → `IconCheckOutlineRegular`。
5. **依赖声明**：`dsh.client.inject` = locale / ui-theme / ui-slots；peerDependencies 只留 `@deepseek-ai/cordis ~4.0.4` + `react ^18.2.0`（不声明 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer，宿主版本检查即通过）。
6. **构建管线**：新增 `scripts/wrap-client.mjs`——把 tsdown ESM 产物后处理为 DSH 要求的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...)` 包裹格式，并直接从 `src/client/` 内联全局主题 CSS（rolldown 会摇掉纯副作用的 CSS 导入，导致早期构建主题整体缺失）。
7. **0.2.x 新布局容器透明化**：`centerCol`/`rightbarCol` 布局列与侧栏面板 frame 根节点的自绘不透明底色置为透明，流体背景可透至主区域。
8. **兼容模式修复**：0.2.x 里 `panel` 类片段命名整栏大容器，已从磨砂选择器中移除（避免半屏模糊）。
9. **新增「恢复默认效果」按钮**：一键恢复出厂默认（保留开关状态）。

细节与历史（含 0.1.1-rc.2 适配记录）见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 开发

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run bundle   # tsdown + tsc + wrap-client.mjs → 完整 lib/
```

# dsh-aqua-input-check — Aquaculture input register completeness and withdrawal-period date check

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-aqua-input-check?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-aqua-input-check?ref=badge)

`dsh-aqua-input-check` reads one aquaculture input register — the farm header plus one row per input record — and checks that register's own completeness and date arithmetic: that each record names its pond and species, that a named input records its quantity and use date, that the use date is not in the future, that harvesting respects the withdrawal period the record itself states, that a stocking record carries its source and quarantine certificate number, that the input type comes from your configured vocabulary, and that batch numbers are unique.
It does not decide whether farming practice is compliant, whether the product is safe to eat, whether medication was appropriate, or whether a penalty applies.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-aqua-input-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-aqua-input-check'
```

## What it looks like

![Workflow diagram for dsh-aqua-input-check: document → rule pack → findings.](docs/assets/dsh-aqua-input-check-flow.svg)

*Workflow overview: document → rule pack → findings. The examples below use the real command surface.*



## What it answers

### Examples

The table below is the example set: the first row is the detailed walkthrough, the remaining rows are short cases.

#### Detailed output

**Tool** `aqua_input_check`

**Input**

~~~json
{"rows":[{"序号":"1","塘口编号":"","养殖品种":"","投苗日期":"2026-02-20", ...}]}
~~~
 
**Output**

~~~json
{
  "id": "dsh-aqua-input-check.AQ-001.de09b5a6",
  "ruleId": "AQ-001",
  "severity": "warn",
  "locator": {
    "row": 1,
    "field": "pondNo"
  },
  "found": "第 1 行 pondNo、species 都为空",
  "expected": "pondNo、species 至少应填写一项",
  "fix": "补填塘口编号与养殖品种；本条只核对是否填写"
}
~~~

*Observed from `dsh-aqua-input-check/tests/fixtures/AQ-001/AQ-001-unsafe.json; dsh-aqua-input-check/tests/fixtures/AQ-001/cases.json; dsh-aqua-input-check/rules/aqua-input-check.yaml; dsh-aqua-input-check/tests/index.test.ts`*

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A record names the input but leaves the pond and the species column empty. | `AQ-001` requires at least one of `pondNo` and `species` on every record. It only checks that one of the two is filled in, and does not judge whether that input is suitable for that species. |
| The input name is there, but the quantity and the use date are blank. | `AQ-002` asks for `inputQty` and `usedAt` whenever `inputName` is filled in. It checks that the fields are recorded, not that the dosage is appropriate or that the medication suits the disease. |
| The use date is written as `15/03/2026`, and one row carries next month's date. | `AQ-003` accepts `2026-03-15` and `2026-03-15 09:30`; a `usedAt` it cannot parse is reported as unparseable, and one later than the check date is reported as a future date. It does not touch the withdrawal period — the pack ships no withdrawal days at all. |
| We treated on 1 June with 20 withdrawal days recorded and harvested on 15 June. Is that caught? | Yes. `AQ-004` compares `usedAt`, `harvestAt` and the record's own `withdrawalDays`, and reports the row as short by the difference. A finding means "by the withdrawal period you recorded, harvest came early" — not that the product is unsafe, which needs a residue test this plugin cannot see. If those three fields are not all filled and parseable, the rule reports `skipped` instead of assuming a period. |
| The input type we use is not in the list — nothing is reported. | `AQ-006` reports `skipped` because the pack ships no input-type vocabulary: `values` is empty until you configure one. Once set, the rule checks that the stored `inputType` is one of your values. It does not judge whether that input may lawfully be used — that needs the prohibited-drug list and the product's approval number. |
| The same batch number appears in two rows. | `AQ-007` reports the repeat and names both rows. It compares with whitespace ignored; several input entries for one batch are normal as long as they share the batch number — do not reuse the row-number column for it. With no batch-number column it reports that it could not run instead of passing silently. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《水产养殖质量安全管理规定》 | 农业部令（现行令号与条号本次未核实） | AQ-001, AQ-002, AQ-005, AQ-007 |
| 《绿色食品 渔药使用准则》 | NY/T 755—2022（2022-07-11 发布、2022-10-01 实施；全部代替已废止的 NY/T 755—2013；属绿色食品系列标准；条号本次未取得） | AQ-003, AQ-004 |
| 本机构养殖生产管理口径（本机构配置） | 无统一标准（本条依据为本机构配置的类型口径） | AQ-006 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks an **水产养殖投入品记录** for completeness and date arithmetic — that each record
names its pond and species, that a named input records its quantity and use date, that the use date is not in the
future, that harvesting respects the withdrawal period the record states, that stocking records its source and
quarantine certificate, that the input type comes from your vocabulary, and that batch numbers are unique. It does
**not** decide whether farming practice is compliant, whether the product is safe to eat, whether medication was
appropriate, or whether a penalty applies.

> ### ⚠️ What this plugin deliberately does not know
>
> **It ships no withdrawal periods.** `AQ-004` checks that the harvest date is at least as many days after the use
> date as **the record's own withdrawal-period column says**. So a finding means "**by the withdrawal period you
> recorded, harvest came N days early**" — never "this product is unsafe". Residue safety needs a test result,
> which this plugin cannot see. A record with no harvest date reports itself in `skipped` rather than assuming a
> period.
>
> **It ships no list of permitted or prohibited inputs.** `AQ-006` checks that the input type is one you
> configured; whether a product may lawfully be used requires the prohibited-drug list and the product's approval
> number, and this plugin does not go there.
>
> **Every `excerpt` in the rule pack says, in so many words, that the clause text was not obtained.** The regime
> lives in 《水产养殖质量安全管理规定》, NY 5361, NY/T 755 and GB 13078. The verification pass could not
> retrieve verbatim clause text, so the pack states the gap in the `excerpt` field itself and keeps every rule at
> `warn` or `info`. **When the texts are in hand, replace each `excerpt` with the real clause and raise `kind`
> to `direct`.**

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. `engines.dsh` is declared as `>=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0` and is enforced by the host since 0.2.1 |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native` and `ptc`; for a season of records use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `aqua_input_check` tool. It reads one input register — the farm header plus one row per input
record — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AQ-001` | the pond and species are recorded | warn | principle |
| `AQ-002` | a named input records its quantity and date | warn | principle |
| `AQ-003` | the use date is not in the future | warn | principle |
| `AQ-004` | harvest respects the recorded withdrawal period | warn | principle |
| `AQ-005` | stocking records its source and quarantine number | warn | principle |
| `AQ-006` | the input type comes from your vocabulary (off by default) | info | local |
| `AQ-007` | batch numbers are unique | warn | principle |

## Configuration

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rulesFile` | string | `rules/aqua-input-check.yaml` | Rule-pack path, relative to the pac

# dsh-contract-stance — Contract clause stance register completeness and self-consistency check

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-contract-stance?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-contract-stance?ref=badge)

`dsh-contract-stance` reads one clause-stance register — the contract header plus one row per clause — and checks that register's own completeness and self-consistency: that each clause's text is recorded, that your stance comes from your own vocabulary, that the risk grade does too, that a must-have clause records both a fallback position and an owner, that clause numbers are unique, that the register names the contract and your side, and that no unreplaced placeholder survives in the clause text.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-contract-stance
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-contract-stance'
```

## What it looks like

![Workflow diagram for dsh-contract-stance: call → plugin → result.](docs/assets/dsh-contract-stance-flow.svg)

*Workflow overview: call → plugin → result. The examples below use the real command surface.*



## What it answers

### Examples

The table below is the example set: the first row is the detailed walkthrough, the remaining rows are short cases.

#### Detailed output

**Tool** `contract_stance`

**Input**

~~~json
{"rows":[{"条款号":"第 8.2 条","条款主题":"逾期付款违约金","条款原文":"", ...}]}
~~~
 
**Output**

~~~json
{
  "id": "dsh-contract-stance.CS-001.de09b5a6",
  "ruleId": "CS-001",
  "severity": "warn",
  "locator": {
    "row": 1,
    "field": "text"
  },
  "found": "第 1 行「text」为空",
  "expected": "「text」应填写",
  "fix": "补填条款原文；本条只核对是否摘录，不判断条款是否可接受"
}
~~~

*Observed from `dsh-contract-stance/tests/fixtures/CS-001/CS-001-unsafe.json; dsh-contract-stance/tests/fixtures/CS-001/cases.json; dsh-contract-stance/rules/contract-stance.yaml; dsh-contract-stance/tests/index.test.ts`*

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A clause row carries a topic, but the clause-text column is blank. Is that reported? | Yes. `CS-001` requires the `text` column on every row: without the wording, a stance cannot be checked against what it is a stance on. The rule checks only that the wording is recorded — it does not judge whether the clause should be accepted or whether it carries legal risk. |
| The stance and the risk grade are both filled in, yet every row comes back as `skipped`. Why? | Both value lists ship empty. `CS-002` accepts a stance only from the list configured for it, and `CS-003` does the same for the risk grade; with no list configured neither rule can run, so each reports itself in `skipped` rather than passing quietly. `CS-002` checks only that the value is on your list, not that the stance is appropriate; `CS-003` checks only that the grade is on your list, not how high the actual risk of that clause is. |
| A clause is marked must-have, but nobody wrote how far we can concede or who decides. | `CS-004` reads the register's own must-have column: for a row marked `是`, `Y`, `yes`, `true`, `必保` or `√` (the values set by `conditionValues`) it requires both the `fallback` and the `owner` column to be filled. It checks only that those two are filled, not whether the fallback is reasonable; which clauses count as must-have depends entirely on the project, and the rule never decides that. |
| The same clause number appears on two rows, one per negotiating draft. Is that a finding? | `CS-005` reports a repeated clause number, comparing with whitespace ignored. A repeated number makes it impossible to point at one clause precisely. One clause appearing once per draft is a normal shape: distinguish it in the version column instead of reusing the number. No clause requires clause numbers to be unique — uniqueness is what makes the register referable. |
| The header does not say which contract this is, nor which side we are. | `CS-006` requires the material's header to state `contractName` and `party`: without those two, a stance cannot be traced to a specific transaction and party. If your form carries a version column for negotiating drafts, add it to that rule's `fields`. The rule only checks that the header declares those two. |
| The clause text was copied straight from a model form and still contains 【】 or TBD. | `CS-007` reports clause text that still holds any of its placeholder terms — `【`, `】`, `{{`, `}}`, `XXX`, `xxx`, `待填`, `待补充`, `TBD`, `todo`, `示例` — which can be adjusted to your own template. Referring to a model form is allowed; the danger is that a template placeholder is read as wording already reviewed. The rule only looks for those terms in the `text` column, not at the clause itself. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《中华人民共和国民法典》 | 现行版本与条号本次未核实 | CS-001, CS-002, CS-003, CS-004, CS-005, CS-006, CS-007 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **合同条款立场台账** for what a register can be held to — that each clause's
text is recorded, that your stance comes from your vocabulary, that the risk grade does too, that a must-have
clause records both a fallback position and an owner, that clause numbers are unique, that the register names
the contract and your side, and that no placeholder survives. It does **not** decide whether a clause should be
accepted, whether a risk is bearable, whether to sign, or whether a negotiating strategy is sound. **Those
depend on the deal, the counterparty's leverage and your own risk appetite.**

> ### ⚠️ What the citation rests on — and one thing this plugin must never be given
>
> **《中华人民共和国民法典》was obtained and read verbatim**, and `rules/evidence/clause-verification.md`
> records what was quoted: article 465 (a contract lawfully formed is protected by law), article 470 (contract
> content **一般包括** the parties, subject matter, quantity, quality, price, performance terms and liability for
> breach), article 509, article 577 (the consequences of breach) and article 584 (damages include expected
> profits but are capped by **foreseeability**).
>
> **The contract part does not regulate a negotiation register.** It governs formation, validity, performance and
> liability; the register's columns come from your enterprise's own contract management rules. So the `excerpt`
> fields still say "本次未取得" and every rule stays `warn` or `info`: **"this column is blank" must not be read
> as "this breaches the Civil Code".** Note also that article 470 says **一般包括**, not 应当包括 — one more
> reason `CS-001` does not claim a direct obligation.
>
> ⚠️ **Do not add a limitation-period rule to this plugin.** The Code *does* fix numbers — article 188 sets a
> three-year limitation (twenty years at the outside) and article 203 rolls a period forward off a public
> holiday — which makes "just compare the dates" look tempting. It is not workable here: the period runs from
> **when the creditor knew or ought to have known** of the harm and the debtor, a finding of fact the register
> does not record; the period is also subject to suspension (article 194) and interruption (article 195), and
> article 196 lists claims the limitation does not apply to at all. A date-arithmetic rule would dress a factual
> finding up as a calculation, which is precisely the over-claim this family avoids.
>
> **No judgement about the substance of a clause is made anywhere in this plugin.** It reads your own columns
> and checks only that they are filled and drawn from your vocabulary. Two vocabularies ship **empty** — the
> stance list (`CS-002`) and the risk grades (`CS-003`) — so with nothing configured those rules report
> themselves in `skipped` rather than passing quietly.

# dsh-learning-gap-check — Competency gap and development plan register check

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-learning-gap-check?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-learning-gap-check?ref=badge)

`dsh-learning-gap-check` reads one competency-gap and development-plan register — the employee header plus one row per competency — and checks that register's own arithmetic and closure: that each gap names its position and competency, that the recorded levels parse as numbers, that the gap equals the required level minus the actual level, that a gap beyond your configured threshold carries a development action, that an action names an owner and a due date, that the completion date is not later than the deadline, and that the action status comes from your own vocabulary.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-learning-gap-check
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-learning-gap-check'
```

## What it looks like

![Workflow diagram for dsh-learning-gap-check: document → rule pack → findings.](docs/assets/dsh-learning-gap-check-flow.svg)

*Workflow overview: document → rule pack → findings. The examples below use the real command surface.*



## What it answers

### Examples

The table below is the example set: the first row is the detailed walkthrough, the remaining rows are short cases.

#### Detailed output

**Tool** `learning_gap_check`

**Input**

~~~json
{"employee":"张工","department":"设备部","rows":[{"岗位":"","能力项":"","要求等级":"4","现有等级":"2","差距等级":"2"}]}
~~~
 
**Output**

~~~json
{
  "id": "dsh-learning-gap-check.LG-001.de09b5a6",
  "ruleId": "LG-001",
  "severity": "warn",
  "locator": {
    "row": 1,
    "field": "position"
  },
  "found": "第 1 行 position、competency 都为空",
  "expected": "position、competency 至少应填写一项"
}
~~~

*Observed from `dsh-learning-gap-check/tests/fixtures/LG-001/LG-001-unsafe.json`*

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A row carries the competency but leaves the position blank. | `LG-001` reports a row only when `position` and `competency` are both empty; one of the two filled is enough. It checks that the row names a post and a competency, not whether the competency requirement for that post is reasonable or complete. |
| Our levels are written as words (`熟练`, `掌握`) or as letters (`A`/`B`/`C`) — what happens? | `LG-002` reads `actualLevel` and requires it to parse as a number, so a level written as a word or a letter is reported as unparseable. The plugin ships no competency scale: convert the register to a numeric scale, or disable `LG-002` together with `LG-003`. Parseability is all it checks — whether the assessment was objective or accurate is not judged. |
| The gap column says `3`, but required `4` minus actual `2` is `2` — does that get caught? | `LG-003` recomputes `requiredLevel − actualLevel` with a tolerance of `0` and reports the row whose stored `gapLevel` disagrees. It runs only when all three columns hold parseable numbers; if one is missing the rule goes to `skipped`. A negative gap is reported as it stands, because the columns may have been transposed, and the rule does not decide how large a gap counts as a problem. |
| A row records a development action but no owner and no due date. | `LG-005` requires `owner` and `dueAt` on every row whose `action` is filled, and reports the row missing either one. It checks that the two fields are recorded; it does not judge whether the action is effective or the deadline reasonable. |
| A row's completion date is later than its due date, or the two columns were filled in the wrong order. | `LG-006` compares `dueAt` with `completedAt` on every row and reports the row when the due date falls before the completion date. The pack states its limit in its own words: it compares only the order of the two dates and does not decide whether the work was really completed on schedule. A date it cannot parse is reported in its own right instead of being passed over. |
| `LG-004` and `LG-007` never report anything — does that mean my register passed them? | No: both rules report themselves in `skipped`. `LG-004` ships with `threshold: 0`, which means unconfigured — set the gap size at which a development action becomes mandatory. `LG-007` ships with an empty status vocabulary — fill it from your institution's own wording. Once configured, `LG-004` checks only that the action column is filled and `LG-007` only that the status value is in your vocabulary; neither judges whether the action was really carried out. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《质量管理 能力管理和人员发展指南》 | GB/T 19025—2023（质量管理 能力管理和人员发展指南；2023-03-17 发布并实施；归口全国质量管理和质量保证标准化技术委员会；条号本次未取得） | LG-001, LG-002, LG-003, LG-005, LG-006 |
| 本机构培训与发展管理口径（本机构配置） | 无统一标准（本条依据为本机构配置的差距阈值） | LG-004 |
| 本机构培训与发展管理口径（本机构配置） | 无统一标准（本条依据为本机构配置的状态口径） | LG-007 |

**Boundary:** this plugin checks a **能力差距与培养计划台账** for arithmetic and closure — that each gap names its
position and competency, that the two level columns parse as numbers, that the gap equals required minus actual,
that a gap beyond your threshold carries a development action, that an action names an owner and a due date, that
the completion date is not later than the deadline, and that the action status comes from your vocabulary. It does
**not** decide whether an employee is competent, whether an assessment was objective, whether a development action
worked, or whether someone should be reassigned or dismissed.

> ### ⚠️ What this plugin deliberately leaves out
>
> **It ships no competency scale, and it assumes the levels are numbers.** `LG-002` and `LG-003` read three
> numeric columns and check the arithmetic between them. A register using letter grades (`A`/`B`/`C`) or words
> (`熟练`/`掌握`) is **reported as unparseable**, because comparing such levels is a modelling decision the
> plugin will not make for you. Convert the scale, or disable those rules.
>
> **It ships no threshold for "big enough to need action".** How much of a gap obliges a development action is
> the institution's talent-management call — some units require one for any shortfall, others tolerate a step —
> so `LG-004`'s threshold starts at `0` and the rule reports itself in `skipped` until you set it.
>
> **The status vocabulary ships empty** for the same reason. And the date rule checks only that the deadline
> does not precede the completion date, which is a data-entry property: **it does not judge whether the work was
> done late.**
>
> **Every `excerpt` in the rule pack says, in so many words, that the clause text was not obtained.** The regime
> lives in GB/T 19025 (identical to ISO 10015) and each institution's qualification and training rules. The
> verification pass could not retrieve verbatim clause text, so the pack states the gap in the `excerpt` field
> itself and keeps every rule at `warn` or `info`. **When the texts are in hand, replace each `excerpt` with the
> real clause and raise `kind` to `direct`.**

## Compatibility

| Surface | Status |
|---|---|
| Harness | Peer range `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.2.0 \|\| >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — verified to accept both `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`. `engines.dsh` is declared as `>=0.2.1-0 <0.3.0` and is enforced by the host since 0.2.1 |
| Node | `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| Platforms | All (plain ESM; no native code, no network, no model call) |
| Tool mode | Works in `native` and `ptc`; for a department's plan use `ptc` |

## What it does

Registers the `learning_gap_check` tool. It reads one gap-and-plan register — the employee header plus one row per
competency — applies a versioned rule pack, and returns a report.

| Rule | Check | Severity | Basis kind |
|---|---|---|---|
| `LG-001` | the position and competency are recorded | warn | principle |
| `LG-002` | the actual level parses as a number | warn | principle |
| `LG-003` | the gap equals required minus actual | warn | principle |

# dsh-protest-deadline — Query and complaint register date and deadline check

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README-zh.md) · [Español](README-es.md) · [Português](README-pt.md) · [हिन्दी](README-hi.md)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/dsh-protest-deadline?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/en/plugins/PerryLink/dsh-protest-deadline?ref=badge)

`dsh-protest-deadline` reads one query-and-complaint register (质疑与投诉台账) — the project header plus one row per query — and checks what such a register can be held to mechanically: that the date the query was raised or the date it was answered is recorded, that the dates parse and follow one another, that the reply falls inside the deadline the register itself states, that every status comes from your own vocabulary, that the query numbers are unique, and that the header names the procurement project.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-protest-deadline
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config | grep 'dsh-protest-deadline'
```

## What it looks like

![Workflow diagram for dsh-protest-deadline: call → plugin → result.](docs/assets/dsh-protest-deadline-flow.svg)

*Workflow overview: call → plugin → result. The examples below use the real command surface.*



## What it answers

### Examples

The table below is the example set: the first row is the detailed walkthrough, the remaining rows are short cases.

#### Detailed output

**Tool** `protest_deadline`

**Input**

~~~json
{"project":"某某设备采购项目","projectNo":"ZC-2026-018","rows":[{"序号":"ZY-2026-001","质疑人":"某某科技有限公司","质疑提出日期":"","答复收到日期":"2026-03-07","答复期限":"2026-03-09","实际答复日期":""}]}
~~~
 
**Output**

  "ruleId": "PD-001",
  "severity": "warn",

  "fix": "补填质疑提出日期与答复日期；本条只核对是否填写，不判断是否在法定期限内"
}
~~~

*Observed from `dsh-protest-deadline/tests/fixtures/PD-001/PD-001-unsafe.json (cases.json expects 1×PD-001); executed parseMaterial+runCheck, checkedAt=2026-10-06T00:00:00.000Z`*

| You ask | What it answers |
|---|---|
| A row leaves both the date the query was raised and the date it was answered blank. Is that reported? | Yes. `PD-001` requires at least one of `raisedAt` and `replyAt` on every row and reports the row where both are empty. It checks only that one of the two is filled, not whether the query was raised inside the legal period: that needs the date the supplier knew of the harm, the service date and a working-day count a register usually does not carry. |
| The reply date is written earlier than the raise date. Is that caught? | `PD-002` compares the raise date with the reply date row by row and reports `raisedAt` when it is later than `replyAt`; the same day counts as not later. A value it cannot parse — `2026年3月15日`, say, where `2026-03-15`, `2026/3/15` or `2026-03-15 09:30` would be read — is reported on that row instead of being passed over quietly. The rule only orders the two dates the register carries. |
| Our reply went out after the reply deadline recorded in the register. Was it late? | `PD-003` hard-codes no day count and cannot say “late”: it compares the actual reply date with the deadline written in the register's own `replyDueAt` column, so a finding means “this disagrees with the deadline you recorded”. With that column empty there is nothing to compare against and the rule reports itself in `skipped`, rather than assuming a period. |
| The status column says 已答复, yet nothing came back for it. Why? | `PD-005` compares the status with the vocabulary you configure, and `values` ships empty, so as delivered the rule reports itself in `skipped` — the choice of values belongs to your institution, not to the engine — instead of passing silently. Fill `values` with your own list (待答复, 已答复, 已投诉, 已撤回, …) and any value not on it is reported row by row. It checks that the value is on the list, never how the query should be handled. |
| The header names the project but carries no header-level raise date. Is something missing? | No. `PD-006` checks the header for the procurement project only: its `fields` default to `[project]`, because the raise date is normally a per-row column. If your form does state it in the header, the rule's own note says to set `fields` to `[project, raisedAt]`. A missing project is reported against the header, not against a row. |
| The same query number appears on two rows. | `PD-007` reports the second row and names the first, comparing the numbers with whitespace ignored. A repeat usually means the same query was registered twice or a number was copied — telling those apart is a human call. If the register carries no number column, the rule reports that it does not apply rather than passing. |

## Standards it follows

| Document | Number | Cited by rules |
|---|---|---|
| 《政府采购质疑和投诉办法》 | 财政部令第94号（2017 年 12 月 26 日公布，自 2018 年 3 月 1 日起施行；六章四十五条。⚠️ 本令第四十五条同时废止财政部令第20号《政府采购供应商投诉处理办法》） | PD-001, PD-002, PD-003, PD-004, PD-005, PD-006, PD-007 |
